title: PBCS Consultant
description:
**Company Description**  

Version 1 has celebrating 30 years in Technology Services and continues to be trusted by global brands to deliver solutions that drive customer success. Version 1 has several strategic technology partners including Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems and Snowflake. We’re also an award\-winning employer reflecting how employees are at the heart of Version 1\.


We’ve been awarded: Innovation Partner of the Year Winner 2023 Oracle EMEA Partner Awards, Global Microsoft Modernising Applications Partner of the Year Award 2023, AWS Collaboration Partner of the Year \- EMEA 2023 and Best Workplaces for Women by Great Place To Work in UK and Ireland 2023\.


As a consultancy and service provider, Version 1 is a digital\-first environment and we do things differently. We’re focused on our core values; using these we’ve seen significant growth across our practices and our Digital, Data and Cloud team is preparing for the next phase of expansion. This creates new opportunities for driven and skilled individuals to join one of the fastest\-growing consultancies globally.

 **Job Description**  

Oracle PBCS Consultant with 7\+ years of end\-to\-end implementation and support experience across planning, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting. The ideal candidate will design and build PBCS models, lead client workshops, integrate PBCS with ERP/HR systems, and deliver reliable planning solutions with robust data governance and performance tuning.


\-

**Key Responsibilities**

**Solution Design \& Delivery**

* Lead requirement workshops and translate financial planning needs into scalable PBCS/EPM Cloud solutions.
* Design and build Planning models (Workforce, CapEx, OpEx, Revenue, Project Planning) using EPMA/Standard Planning, Data Forms, Smart Lists, and Business Rules.
* Develop Calculation Manager rules (Groovy/Business Rules) and driver\-based models for scenario, version, and year planning.
* Configure Task Lists, Approvals (Workflow), Validations, and Security (roles, provisioning).

**Data \& Integration**

* Design and manage data integrations using Data Management, Connections, and Oracle EPM Integration Agent; build ETL mappings from ERP/GL/HR systems (e.g., Oracle Fusion ERP, EBS, SAP).
* Orchestrate data loads (files, APIs), validate data quality, and monitor integration jobs.
* Implement dimension management (hierarchies), metadata updates, and substitution variables.

**Reporting \& Analytics**

* Develop executive\-ready reports in Oracle Reports, Dashboards, Infolets, and Smart View (Excel/Office).
* Build variance analyses, driver\-based KPIs, and board\-level reporting packs.
* Enable ad\-hoc analysis and self\-service reporting for Finance users.

**Governance, Performance \& Support**

* Establish design standards, documentation, and testing cycles (SIT, UAT).
* Optimize performance (rule tuning, form design, caching), troubleshoot issues, and drive root\-cause analysis.
* Provide hypercare, user training, and ongoing support; manage enhancements via change control.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with Finance, FP\&A, and IT teams; run demos and user training.
* Manage delivery scope, risks, and timelines; contribute to effort estimation and project planning.

  

**Qualifications** **Required Qualifications**

  

* 7\+ years of hands\-on experience in Oracle PBCS / EPM Cloud Planning (at least 2 full\-cycle implementations).
* Strong expertise with:


o Planning Artifacts: Forms, Rules (Groovy/Calc Manager), Approvals, Validations, Smart Lists, Sub Vars.


o Data Management/Integrations: Mappings, Load Rules, Drill\-through, Integration Agent.


o Reporting: Smart View, Dashboards, and Financial Data modeling.

* Solid understanding of FP\&A processes: Annual budgeting, periodic forecasting, rolling forecast, scenario modeling, allocations, intercompany eliminations, currency translations.
* Proficiency in SQL/CSV data handling, and performance tuning within PBCS.
* Experience with requirements gathering, solution design, and conducting UAT/training.
* Excellent communication skills and client\-facing experience.

**Nice\-to\-Have Skills**

  

* Groovy scripting for advanced business rules.
* Integration exposure to Oracle Fusion ERP/EBS/SAP (GL, Projects, HR).
* Knowledge of REST APIs for EPM Cloud automation.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery and DevOps practices for EPM deployments.
* Experience with Workforce/Project Planning prebuilt modules.

**Education \& Certifications**

* Bachelor’s in finance/accounting/information systems/computer science.
* Preferred: Oracle EPM Cloud certifications (Planning) or equivalent.

**Tools \& Technologies**

* Oracle EPM Cloud (PBCS/EPBCS), Calculation Manager, Groovy.
* Smart View (Excel plugin), Data Management, Integration Agent.
* SQL/Excel, REST APIs, Jira/Confluence, MS Teams.

  

**Additional Information**  

At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their well\-being, professional growth, and financial stability.


One of our standout advantages is the ability to work with a hybrid schedule along with business travel, allowing our employees to strike a balance between work and life. We also offer a range of tech\-related benefits, including an innovative Tech Scheme to help keep our team members up\-to\-date with the latest technology.


We prioritise the health and safety of our employees, providing private medical and life insurance coverage, as well as free eye tests and contributions towards glasses. Our team members can also stay ahead of the curve with incentivized certifications and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat.


Our employee\-designed Profit Share scheme divides a portion of our company's profits each quarter amongst employees. We are dedicated to helping our employees reach their full potential, offering Pathways Career Development Quarterly, a programme designed to support professional growth.

title: Finance Manager
description:
**Job Description – Finance Manager**

**Position Title \- Finance Manager** 

**Department \- Finance \& Accounts**

**Experience Required \- 8 – 12 Years**

**Industry Preference \- Construction / Architecture / Interior Design / Real Estate**

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced and result\-oriented Finance Manager with 8–12 years of experience in the construction, architecture, and interior design industry. The candidate will be responsible for managing the overall financial operations of the organization, leading the finance team, ensuring financial compliance, budgeting, cost control, project finance management, and supporting strategic business decisions.

The ideal candidate should possess strong leadership skills, financial planning expertise, and experience in handling project\-based financial operations within the construction and design sector.

**Key Duties \& Responsibilities**

**1\*.** Financial Planning \& Budget Management\*

Prepare annual budgets, financial forecasts, and project cost plans.

Monitor organizational financial performance and control project expenditures.

Analyze budget variances and recommend corrective actions.

Support management with strategic financial planning and decision\-making.

**2\. Accounting \& Financial Operations**

Oversee daily accounting operations, bookkeeping, and financial transactions.

Ensure accurate maintenance of ledgers, invoices, payments, and financial records.

Review monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.

Manage cash flow, banking operations, and fund utilization efficiently.

**3\. Project Finance \& Cost Control**

Monitor project\-wise costing, profitability, and financial performance.

Ensure proper tracking of construction and interior project expenses.

Control operational costs and optimize financial resources.

Coordinate with project teams regarding project budgets and financial approvals.

**4\. Team Leadership \& Management**

Lead, supervise, and manage the finance and accounts team effectively.

Allocate responsibilities and ensure timely completion of financial tasks.

Provide guidance, performance monitoring, and team development support.

Ensure coordination between finance, procurement, HR, and project departments.

**5\. Compliance \& Audit Management**

Ensure compliance with financial regulations, taxation, and statutory requirements.

Handle GST, TDS, payroll compliance, and other financial statutory processes.

Coordinate internal and external audits and ensure timely audit closure.

Maintain proper financial documentation and compliance records.

**6\. Reporting \& Financial Analysis**

Prepare MIS reports, financial dashboards, and management reports.

Present financial insights and profitability analysis to senior management.

Monitor financial risks and recommend process improvements.

Ensure accurate reporting of project revenue, expenses, and cash flow.

**7\. Vendor \& Payment Management**

Monitor vendor payments, subcontractor billing, and payment schedules.

Verify payment approvals as per project and financial policies.

Maintain healthy financial relationships with vendors and suppliers.

Ensure proper reconciliation of accounts payable and receivable.

**Required Skills \& Competencies**

Strong knowledge of accounting principles and financial management.

Expertise in project finance, budgeting, and cost control.

Knowledge of GST, taxation, statutory compliance, and audit procedures.

Strong analytical, leadership, and decision\-making skills.

Excellent communication and team management abilities.

Proficiency in Tally, ERP systems, MS Excel, and financial reporting tools.

**Educational Qualification**

CA / CMA / MBA Finance / M.Com / B.Com with relevant experience.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Experience in construction, architecture, interior design, or project\-based industries.

Ability to manage multiple projects and financial operations simultaneously.

Strong leadership experience in handling finance and accounts teams.

High attention to detail, confidentiality, and organizational skills.

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Director Of Engineering (Site Lead) - Spend Team
description:
**About Rippling**


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.8B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

### **About The Role**


We’re building a world\-class Spend org in Bangalore and looking for a senior engineering leader to serve as our local site lead while directly owning the Accounting Integrations team. This is a rare 0 to 1 plus scale role: you’ll stand up the Bangalore hub, hire and coach managers and ICs, and ship the accounting integration platform that powers Rippling’s finance suite (corporate cards, reimbursements, travel, and accounting automation).

  

You’ll wear two hats:

* Site Lead (matrix): Be the senior presence for Spend in Bangalore—set a high bar, unblock teams, drive performance management, and ensure crisp product\<\>engineering execution across reimbursements, travel integrations, and accounting integrations.
* Direct Owner (line): Lead the Accounting Integrations team to build both the platform and the first wave of integrations (e.g., QuickBooks, Microsoft, and others). You’ll create repeatable pipelines, operational tooling, and the quality bar for how Rippling ships integrations.

  

If you thrive on ownership, love building teams and systems, and want material impact on a product with massive TAM, this is for you.

 **Why this role?**

  

* 0 to 1 with leverage: Your platform unlocks multiple product lines (Spend, Travel, Payroll).
* Massive scope: Travel \+ Spend are multibillion\-dollar markets; integrations are a core growth lever.
* Career runway: Build the Bangalore Spend org from the ground up and shape the architecture and culture that others scale

 **What You'll Do**

* Build the Bangalore hub: Hire, level, and grow a 25\+ person org; stand up rituals, on\-call, quality bars, and velocity tracking.
* Own Accounting Integrations end\-to\-end: Define the technical roadmap and delivery plan for an integrations platform that serves both Spend and Payroll; ship the next set of GA integrations.
* Raise the execution bar: Diagnose churn early, clarify requirements, and drive PR/Design quality; get teams shipping the right thing, fast.
* Manage managers \+ ICs: Mentor junior EMs; directly manage ICs initially and transition scope as leaders ramp.
* Operational excellence: Build support and observability for integrations (routing, retries, idempotency, reconciliation, data quality, SLAs).
* Partner deeply: Work with Product, Design, GTM, and Finance Ops to prioritize impact, measure outcomes, and iterate quickly.
* Scale through platforms: Establish reusable contracts, SDKs, tooling, and CI/CD standards so new integrations land in weeks—not quarters.
* Be the site leader: Set crisp goals, run calibration, address underperformance fast, and model hands\-on, detail\-oriented leadership.

### **Qualifications**

* 5\+ years in engineering leadership, including 2\+ years managing managers or large multi\-team groups
* Proven 0 to 1 and scale experience: shipped platforms or integrations with high reliability and throughput
* You like being technical. Strong technical depth in distributed systems, APIs/webhooks, and data modeling. Comfortable reviewing designs and PRs
* Operational mindset: built systems with monitoring, alerting, rate limits, retries, reconciliation, and clear SLOs/SLAs
* People leader: hires great talent, levels accurately, runs calibrations, manages performance with candor and speed
* Product sense: You can turn ambiguous requirements into shipped outcomes while balancing speed with quality
* Nice to have: prior work with accounting/ERP systems, travel content providers, or financial data flows

title: HR Recruiter
description:
**About Blackstone Group Technologies Pvt Ltd**

Blackstone Group Technologies Pvt Ltd (BGT) is a globally recognized technology and engineering services company with over **30 years of experience** in structural steel detailing, BIM solutions, advanced robotic fabrication, and engineering consultancy. Headquartered in **Chicago, Illinois**, BGT operates a state\-of\-the\-art **30,000 sq. ft. ODC in India**, serving clients across Commercial, Institutional, Healthcare, Industrial, and Mining sectors in the US and Canada.

Driven by precision, quality, and innovation, BGT has built strong, long\-standing partnerships with leading global organizations. At BGT, **people are our greatest asset** — and we continuously invest in nurturing the next generation of talent to sustain our legacy of excellence.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a passionate and detail\-oriented **HR Recruiter (Fresher)** to join our HR team at Blackstone Group Technologies Pvt Ltd. This is a great opportunity for **2025 \& 2026 batch graduates** to gain hands\-on exposure to the complete recruitment lifecycle — from sourcing and screening candidates to scheduling interviews, stakeholder follow\-ups, and facilitating smooth hiring. You will also participate in conducting initial interview rounds, building practical experience in candidate evaluation and hiring decisions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Talent Sourcing \& Candidate Management**

● Source and attract candidates through various platforms including job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, Shine), social media, employee referrals, and campus recruitment drives.

● Create and post compelling and accurate job advertisements in alignment with role requirements and company culture.

● Build and maintain a robust talent pipeline for current and future hiring needs across various departments.

● Screen resumes and application forms to shortlist candidates who match the required qualifications and experience profile.

**Interview Scheduling \& Coordination**

● Schedule and coordinate interviews between shortlisted candidates and the respective hiring managers or department heads.

● Manage interview logistics — sending calendar invites, sharing interview formats, and ensuring all stakeholders are well\-prepared.

● Coordinate panel availability and ensure timely scheduling without conflicts or delays.

● Maintain organized records of interview schedules, outcomes, and feedback in the ATS (Applicant Tracking System) or HR systems.

**Candidate Follow\-Up \& Communication**

● Proactively follow up with candidates at every stage of the recruitment process to keep them informed and engaged.

● Send timely communication including interview confirmations, feedback notifications, offer letters, and onboarding instructions.

● Build positive candidate relationships and maintain a professional, empathetic, and responsive communication approach.

● Track candidate drop\-offs, understand reasons, and provide feedback to improve the candidate experience.

**Interview Participation \& Evaluation**

● Actively participate in conducting initial screening rounds and HR interviews for shortlisted candidates.

● Evaluate candidates on communication skills, attitude, cultural fit, and overall suitability for the role.

● Share structured feedback and hiring recommendations with senior HR team members after each interview.

● Develop and refine interview questionnaires and competency\-based assessment tools over time.

**End\-to\-End Recruitment Support**

● Manage the complete recruitment workflow — from job requisition receipt to offer rollout and pre\-onboarding formalities.

● Coordinate with department heads to understand exact hiring requirements, timelines, and job specifications.

● Maintain and update daily/weekly recruitment trackers and MIS reports for management review.

● Assist in organizing walk\-in drives, job fairs, and campus placement events as required.

● Support the onboarding process by coordinating documentation, induction scheduling, and day\-one readiness for new joiners.

**Qualifications \& Requirements**

**Educational Qualification**

● MBA/MSW (Human Resources) from a recognized university or institution.

● Candidates who have completed their degree in the year 2025 or 2026 are eligible to apply.

● Candidates awaiting results of their final semester/year are also encouraged to apply (subject to qualification confirmation).

**Skills \& Competencies**

● Strong verbal and written communication skills in English; knowledge of regional languages is an added advantage.

● Good interpersonal skills with the ability to engage professionally with candidates, hiring managers, and team members.

● Basic proficiency in Microsoft Office tools — Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

● Familiarity with job portals such as Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, or Shine is preferred.

● Ability to multitask, prioritize workloads, and work effectively under deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.

● High attention to detail with strong organizational and follow\-up skills.

● Eagerness to learn, take ownership, and grow within the HR function.

**What You Will Gain at BGT**

This role is designed to give fresh HR graduates a comprehensive, real\-world understanding of the recruitment function in a professionally managed, globally connected organization. As part of the BGT HR team, you will:

● Gain end\-to\-end exposure to the entire recruitment lifecycle in an international work environment.

● Develop hands\-on skills in talent sourcing, candidate engagement, interview facilitation, and offer management.

● Learn to work with structured HR processes, tools, and reporting systems.

● Receive mentorship from experienced HR professionals and leadership teams.

● Build confidence in conducting interviews and assessing talent across varied roles and seniority levels.

● Be part of a reputed, 30\+ year old engineering and technology organization with a strong global presence.

description:
Detailed Job Description

Detailed Job Description

Prepared for recruitment and HR agency circulation

Field Details

Role Management Trainee \- Warehouse \&

Client Operations

Department Warehousing \& Supply Chain Operations

Location Warehouse\-based role \- Delhi

Experience Freshers / 0\-1 year

Role Overview

GMS Worldwide Express Pvt. Ltd. is looking for young, energetic, and highly communicative supply\-chain graduates

who are willing to build their career in warehousing, logistics, and client operations.

This role is designed for freshers or early\-career candidates from a supply chain, logistics, operations, or business

management background. The selected candidate will be trained in warehouse operations, inventory control, inbound

and outbound processes, WMS usage, client coordination, MIS reporting, and day\-to\-day operational monitoring.

The candidate will not be expected to perform manual pick\-and\-pack work. However, the candidate must be willing to

work from the warehouse floor, monitor activities closely, coordinate with internal teams, ensure process discipline,

and communicate professionally with clients and management.

This role is ideal for candidates who want to grow into future warehouse managers, assistant managers, key account

operations executives, or supply chain operations leaders.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Warehouse Operations Monitoring

Monitor day\-to\-day warehouse activities including inbound, stocking, inventory movement, order processing, picking,

packing, dispatch, returns, and coordination with transport teams.

Ensure that warehouse activities are carried out as per defined SOPs, client requirements, and internal process

standards.

Coordinate with warehouse in\-charges, supervisors, DEOs, pickers, packers, and transport teams to ensure smooth

operational flow.

Track whether daily tasks are completed on time and highlight delays or process gaps to the reporting manager.

2\. Inventory \& WMS Coordination

Monitor inventory accuracy in the warehouse and system.

Support the team in ensuring correct scanning, binning, stock updates, serial number tracking, condition\-based

inventory handling, and timely WMS updates.

Coordinate with the WMS/data entry team to ensure that all inbound, outbound, and inventory movements are

updated correctly.

Highlight mismatches, short or excess stock, damages, wrong entries, ageing inventory, pending updates, or any stock

discrepancies to the reporting manager.

3\. Client Coordination \& Communication

Act as a coordination point between the warehouse team, internal management, and client\-facing teams.

Communicate professionally over email and calls with internal stakeholders and, wherever required, client teams.

Prepare clear updates on warehouse status, pending activities, dispatches, inventory issues, escalations, and

operational challenges.

Since GMS handles international clients, especially UK\-based and France\-based clients, excellent English

communication is a mandatory requirement.

4\. MIS, Reporting \& Follow\-Up

Prepare and share daily/weekly operational reports as per internal and client requirements.

Track inbound, outbound, pending orders, inventory discrepancies, dispatch status, pickup status, delivery

coordination, and ageing cases.

Follow up with internal teams to close pending tasks and maintain proper documentation and reporting discipline.

Support the reporting manager with accurate data, clear summaries, and timely escalation points.

5\. Process Improvement \& Escalation

Identify operational gaps and report them to management.

Support in improving warehouse workflows, documentation, reporting formats, and accountability.

Escalate delays, stock mismatches, manpower issues, process deviations, documentation issues, or client\-impacting

matters on time.

Observe day\-to\-day warehouse functioning and suggest practical improvements wherever possible.

6\. Learning \& Development

Undergo training in GMS warehouse operations, client\-specific SOPs, WMS usage, inventory handling, transport

coordination, and reporting.

Develop into a future warehouse operations leader, assistant manager, or key account operations executive.

Learn warehouse operations from the ground level while building strong communication, reporting, and client

coordination skills.

Candidate Profile

Qualification

Bachelor’s degree / MBA / diploma in any of the following preferred:

* Supply Chain Management
* Logistics Management
* Operations Management
* Business Administration
* Commerce
* Industrial Engineering or related field

Freshers can apply. Candidates with 0\-1 year of internship or work experience in logistics, warehousing, supply chain,

e\-commerce, distribution, or operations will be preferred.

Mandatory Skills

* Excellent English communication \- written and spoken
* Strong email drafting skills
* Good coordination and follow\-up ability
* Willingness to work from the warehouse
* Good understanding of MS Excel / Google Sheets
* Ability to learn WMS/software systems
* Strong observation and reporting skills
* High ownership and accountability
* Ability to work with warehouse staff, supervisors, transport teams, and management
* Willingness to learn warehouse operations from the ground level

Important Note

This is a warehouse\-based operations role, not a desk\-only office role.

The candidate must be comfortable working from the warehouse floor, monitoring live operations, coordinating with

multiple teams, and ensuring that activities are completed properly.

The candidate will not be required to do manual loading, unloading, or pick\-and\-pack work, but must be actively

involved in supervising, checking, coordinating, and reporting warehouse activities.

Preferred Personality

* Confident communicator
* Smart and quick learner
* Professional in email and verbal communication
* Not hesitant to work in a warehouse environment
* Detail\-oriented
* Disciplined and punctual
* Able to handle pressure
* Able to speak to clients and internal teams professionally
* Interested in building a long\-term career in supply chain and logistics

Compensation

Salary range: Rs. 30,000 to Rs. 35,000 take\-home per month, depending on communication skills, educational

background, and interview performance.

Exceptional candidates may be considered more at the time of discussion.

Growth path will be available based on performance, learning ability, ownership, and client\-handling capability.

Career Growth Path

The selected candidate will initially be trained as a Management Trainee / Executive in Warehouse \& Client Operations.

Based on performance, the candidate can grow into roles such as:

* Senior Executive \- Warehouse \& Client Operations
* Assistant Manager \- Warehouse Operations
* Key Account Operations Executive
* Warehouse Operations Manager
* Supply Chain Operations Lead

* Guide candidates through documentation, visa, medical, and deployment procedures.

Negotiation \& Relationship Management

* Build and maintain strong relationships with candidates and clients.
* Handle candidate concerns and resolve recruitment\-related issues professionally.

Documentation \& Compliance

* Ensure compliance with company policies and overseas recruitment regulations.
* Maintain accurate recruitment records and reports.
* Prepare recruitment reports and status updates for management.

Experience

* Experience handling bulk hiring and international client requirements is an added advantage.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Strong negotiation and persuasion skills.

title: Branch Manager
description:
Designation:


Location: India Uttar Pradesh Mohalla Ram Nagar Sharanpur


Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Organization Context**
Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.  

ABCL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABCL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII. **Business Context**
Gold Loans is a key secured lending product with high volume, fast turnaround expectations and requires strict discipline in risk, valuation, purity testing, and customer trust management. **Job Context:**

**What would you do?** The HRMS OM Specialist is responsible for maintaining the integrity, accuracy, and hierarchy of the organization’s structure within the Human Resources Management System (HRMS). You will bridge the gap between HR strategy and technical execution, ensuring that every "box" on the org chart is correctly defined, funded, and aligned with business goals. Employee Services refer to the support and resources provided by an organization to its employees. This includes HR assistance, payroll processing, benefits administration, training programs, and wellness initiatives. The goal is to enhance employee satisfaction, productivity, and overall well\-being. The design of employee data processes to manage employment data, records and transactions using standard technologies and processes.  

**What are we looking for?** Education: Bachelor’s degree in HR, Information Systems, or Business Administration. Technical Proficiency in HRMS modules (OM/PA) and advanced Excel (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables). Analytical Ability to interpret complex organizational charts and translate them into system logic. Attention to Detail High precision in data entry; a single wrong "Parent ID" can break company\-wide workflows. Communication Ability to explain technical system constraints to non\-technical HR Business Partners.
  

**Roles and Responsibilities:** •Structure Maintenance: Create, modify, and delimit organizational units, jobs, positions, and task assignments within the HRMS (e.g., SAP, Workday, Oracle). Hierarchy Management: Ensure reporting lines (Who reports to whom?) are accurate to drive automated workflows for approvals, payroll, and security permissions. Data Integrity: Audit organizational data regularly to identify "orphaned" positions, vacant roles, or incorrect cost center assignments. Restructuring Support: Partner with leadership during mergers, acquisitions, or internal re\-orgs to mass\-upload changes and simulate new structures. Position Control: Manage "Position Management" logic—ensuring new hires are only mapped to approved, budgeted headcount. Reporting \& Analytics: Generate visualizations of the span of control, vacancy rates, and departmental growth trends for executive review.

title: Head of Human Resources
description:
HR Manager – HR Operations, Talent Acquisition \& Cross\-Border Compliance (India \& Saudi Arabia)
 








**Job Summary** 




 We are seeking an experienced and strategic HR professional to lead HR Operations and Talent Acquisition across India and Saudi Arabia. The role requires a strong blend of recruitment expertise, HR operations excellence, labor law compliance, employee relations, and policy management. The ideal candidate will bring 15\+ years of progressive HR experience, with proven capability in managing cross\-border HR operations, scaling teams, and supporting business growth in dynamic environments.
 







 The candidate should also have experience working closely with attorneys/legal counsels on HR policy drafting, employment contracts, disciplinary matters, compliance frameworks, and labor law\-related documentation across multiple jurisdictions.
 







**Key Responsibilities** 









**Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning** 



* Manage the end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle including sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer management, and onboarding
* Partner with business leaders and hiring managers to understand workforce planning and hiring requirements
* Develop and execute effective sourcing strategies through job portals, referrals, social media, and recruitment networks
* Lead hiring initiatives across India and Saudi Arabia, including high\-volume and niche hiring
* Ensure a seamless and positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment process
* Track and analyze recruitment metrics such as time\-to\-hire, cost\-per\-hire, and quality of hire



**HR Operations \& Employee Lifecycle Management** 



* Oversee complete employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, confirmations, transfers, promotions, and exits
* Manage employee records, HR documentation, attendance, leave management, and payroll coordination
* Maintain HRIS systems and ensure employee data accuracy and confidentiality
* Support audits and maintain audit\-ready HR records and documentation
* Streamline HR processes to improve operational efficiency and scalability



  





  





**Compliance \& Labor Law Management** 



* Ensure compliance with Indian labor laws and Saudi labor regulations including Saudization, Iqama, GOSI, visa, and work permit requirements
* Coordinate with PROs and external agencies for employee documentation, visas, and expatriate workforce management
* Work closely with attorneys and legal counsels on HR policy drafting, employment agreements, disciplinary procedures, compliance matters, investigations, and labor law documentation
* Maintain and update HR policies, SOPs, employee handbooks, and compliance frameworks across regions
* Ensure adherence to internal policies, statutory regulations, and corporate governance standards



**Compensation, Benefits \& Performance Management** 



* Manage salary structures, compensation revisions, benchmarking, and benefits administration
* Oversee expatriate compensation, allowances, and per diem structures
* Drive performance appraisal cycles, goal\-setting frameworks, and employee feedback processes
* Support leadership in talent development, succession planning, and retention initiatives



**Employee Relations \& Engagement** 



* Serve as the primary HR point of contact for employee queries and support
* Handle employee grievances, disciplinary actions, investigations, and conflict resolution
* Foster a positive and inclusive work culture across locations
* Lead employee engagement and retention initiatives



**HR Reporting \& Analytics** 



* Generate HR dashboards, MIS reports, and analytics for leadership review
* Provide data\-driven insights to support HR and business decision\-making
* Monitor key HR metrics and recommend process improvements







**Key Requirements** 



* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field
* 15\+ years of progressive experience in HR Operations and Talent Acquisition
* Strong exposure to HR operations in both India and Saudi Arabia
* In\-depth knowledge of Indian labor laws and Saudi labor regulations
* Experience managing cross\-border and expatriate workforce
* Proven experience working with attorneys/legal teams on HR policy drafting, compliance, contracts, and employee relations matters
* Hands\-on experience with HRIS platforms and recruitment tools
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and organizational capabilities
* Ability to thrive in fast\-paced and dynamic business environments







**Preferred Skills** 



* Experience in scaling teams and managing high\-volume recruitment
* Strong analytical mindset with data\-driven decision\-making capabilities
* Exposure to multinational or multi\-location organizations
* Ability to align HR strategy with overall business objectives
* Strong process orientation with a focus on operational excellence

**What would you do?** Improve workforce performance and productivity, boosts business agility, increases revenue and reduces costs Employee Services refer to the support and resources provided by an organization to its employees. This includes HR assistance, payroll processing, benefits administration, training programs, and wellness initiatives. The goal is to enhance employee satisfaction, productivity, and overall well\-being. The design of employee data processes to manage employment data, records and transactions using standard technologies and processes.  

**What are we looking for?** Technical Proficiency in HRMS modules (OM/PA) and advanced Excel (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables). Analytical Ability to interpret complex organizational charts and translate them into system logic. Attention to Detail High precision in data entry; a single wrong "Parent ID" can break company\-wide workflows. Communication: Ability to explain technical system constraints to non\-technical HR Business Partners. Education: Bachelor’s degree in HR, Information Systems, or Business Administration. The HRMS OM Specialist is responsible for maintaining the integrity, accuracy, and hierarchy of the organization’s structure within the Human Resources Management System (HRMS). You will bridge the gap between HR strategy and technical execution, ensuring that every "box" on the org chart is correctly defined, funded, and aligned with business goals.
  

**Roles and Responsibilities:** •Structure Maintenance: Create, modify, and delimit organizational units, jobs, positions, and task assignments within the HRMS (e.g., SAP, Workday, Oracle). Hierarchy Management: Ensure reporting lines (Who reports to whom?) are accurate to drive automated workflows for approvals, payroll, and security permissions. title: Application Security Engineer
description:
**Job Title**
 Application Security Engineer
   

  

**Job Description**
**So, who are we?**
 IG is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1\.3m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that's rare in established businesses.
   

  

 The bar is high – bring a curious and forward\-thinking mindset and we'll give you the platform to define what comes next. Join us at IG – the future gets built here.
   

  

**Your team**
 We are seeking a passionate “Application Security Engineer” who has hands\-on experience in securing applications across SDLC, Penetration Testing. The ideal candidate will be responsible for identifying vulnerabilities, conducting security assessments, collaborating with developers and helping to embed security best practices into product development.
   

  

**Your role in the Team's Success**
 Your role contributes to the success of the AppSec team by proactively identifying and mitigating application security risks, collaborating with developers and product teams to embed security early in the SDLC, Penetration Testing, SAST/DAST, Secret management, WAF, Purple Team Exercise . The position also supports process improvements, leverages automation to deliver security at pace, and helps strengthen overall security awareness across the organization.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Perform security assessments/Penetration Testing of web, mobile, and cloud\-based applications.
* Conduct secure code reviews, threat modelling, and architecture reviews.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate security into CI/CD pipelines.
* Identify, validate, and track remediation of vulnerabilities discovered through SAST, DAST, SCA, and penetration testing.
* Develop and enforce secure coding standards and guidelines.
* Execute Purple Team/Red Team exercise and work closely with SOC team on this.
* Provide training and guidance to developers on application security best practices.
* Research and stay up\-to\-date with emerging security threats, tools, and techniques.
* Support incident response and root cause analysis for application\-related security issues.


**What You'll Need For This Role**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security or related field.
* 3\+ years of professional experience in Application Security / Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) / Cyber security / Offensive Security.
* OSCP certified with hands on experience with Penetration Testing
* Strong understanding of common vulnerabilities and mitigation techniques (OWASP Top 10, SANS 25, etc.).
* Hands\-on experience with one or more security tools:
+ SAST (Checkmarx, Fortify, SonarQube, etc.)
+ DAST (Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, AppScan, etc.)
+ SCA (Black Duck, Snyk, etc.)
+ WAF(Akamai, Barracuda,etc)

* Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and related security controls.
* Exposure to bug bounty programs or responsible disclosure.
* Strong knowledge on Attack simulations/Red team/purple team exercise.
* Working knowledge of DevOps/DevSecOps tools and processes (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD).
* Excellent problem\-solving and communication skills.


**Preferred (Nice\-to\-Have)**
* Experience with container and Kubernetes security.
* Knowledge of API security testing (Postman, SoapUI, or Burp plugins).
* Experience in secure code review.


**How We Work**
 We try to take a thoughtful approach to our ways of working as a company. We follow a hybrid working model with 3 days in the office \-\- which we think balances the need to collaborate effectively and connect with each other. When it comes to how we deliver, there are 5 things we want everyone to do to drive high performance, better learning and career satisfaction:
   

  

* Lead and Inspire: Drives trust, alignment, and enthusiasm
* Think Big: Focus on the problems that most impact commercial outcomes
* Champion the client: Understand and prioritise client's needs
* Deliver at pace: Push for fast, sustainable growth;
* Raise the bar: Take ownership, be accountable and share feedback


 We believe that diversity is vital to success, it fuels creativity, drives innovation and sets us up for global success. We're committed to building teams with a variety of perspectives and skills to help us realise our vision and strategy, that's why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join us on this journey. Learn more about our D\&I approach here.
   

  

**The Perks**
 Your growth fuels our success! Thrive with tailored development programs, mentoring opportunities with leaders, and clear career progression. Expand your network through committees, sports and social clubs. Enjoy extra time off for volunteering and community work.
   

  

 Learn more about the Perks here!

* Handle multiple influencer collaborations and campaigns simultaneously.

* Ensure campaigns are aligned with brand objectives, business goals, and performance expectations.

Performance \& Reporting

* Track campaign performance including reach, engagement, views, conversions, and overall campaign effectiveness.
* Share campaign insights, recommendations, and optimization strategies.
* Focus on conversion\-driven influencer marketing campaigns and measurable campaign outcomes.

* Lead, mentor, and manage junior team members.
* Review team output and ensure quality standards are maintained across campaigns.
* Take complete ownership of campaign execution, team productivity, and delivery timelines.
* Drive accountability, performance, and process improvements within the team.

Skills \& Experience Required

* 4 to 5 years of hands\-on experience exclusively in influencer marketing with end\-to\-end campaign execution.
* Strong understanding of creative, comedy, meme\-based, and trend\-driven content concepts.
* Experience in scripting and guiding creators for high\-performing influencer marketing content.
* Strong understanding of Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, UGC, and short\-form video content.
* Experience handling high\-volume creator collaborations and campaign management simultaneously.
* Strong focus on conversion\-driven influencer campaigns.
* Extensive experience working with micro and nano influencers across multiple categories.
* Good exposure to regional creators and regional content trends.
* Strong negotiation and influencer relationship management skills.
* Strong team management skills with the ability to lead, mentor, and drive team performance.
* Taking complete ownership of campaign execution, team productivity, and delivery timelines.
* Strong business understanding with the ability to align influencer campaigns with brand and performance goals.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and handle pressure effectively.
* Strong attention to detail and problem\-solving skills.
* Good Excel, reporting, and campaign tracking skills.

Experience Requirement

Role Level Experience :

Executive / Junior Executive 1–3 years,

Senior Executive 3–6 years,

Manager 4–5 years

Freshers may be considered only if they have strong marketing understanding, good communication skills and genuine interest in influencer / digital marketing.

description:
**About Vedantu** 




 Vedantu is a leading learning platform delivering value to students across grades and competitive exams. We are on a mission to make high\-quality education accessible and engaging for every learner.
 



**Role Overview** 




 This role sits at the intersection of AI products and revenue systems. You will own the automation and intelligence layer that powers lead qualification, routing, and conversion across Vedantu's sales funnel. Beyond the core systems, you will also run experiments to improve conversion at every funnel stage — from first bot interaction to enrolment. This is a hands\-on role — you will work directly with the tech, the CRM stack, and the sales team to build systems that are fast, intelligent, and measurable.
 



**What You'll Own** 



* AI Voice \& chat \- Own conversation flows, intent design, architecture, escalation logic, and quality. Work with stakeholders to ship, iterate, and drive conversion.
* Lead lifecycle \& routing — Own multi\-signal lead qualification, scoring, and distribution logic. Reduce leakage, improve routing accuracy, and cut time\-to\-first\-contact.
* Automation \& engagement — Build the automation layer — bot follow\-ups, smart scheduling, and multi\-channel activations that reduce manual effort.
* Growth experimentation — Run rapid experiments across the funnel with engineering, marketing, and business. Own the metrics, iterate fast, and ship what works.
* CRM \& integrations — Own LeadSquared configuration, workflows, and integrations across telephony, marketing platforms, payment systems, and internal tools.
* Funnel intelligence — Define real\-time dashboards tracking latency, routing effectiveness, capacity utilisation, and conversion health. Own the metrics leadership acts on.



  





  





**Must\-Have Requirements** 



* Hands\-on experience building voice bots or conversational AI products — from conversation design and intent flows to integration and deployment. Experience with LLMs or intelligent automation is a plus.
* Hands\-on experience with LeadSquared or a similar CRM — workflows, routing rules, and automation sequences ideally at meaningful scale (think millions, not hundreds).
* Demonstrable funnel understanding — ability to identify leakages, diagnose drop\-offs, and connect product decisions to funnel outcomes.
* Strong product discovery skills — user research, experimentation design, prioritisation frameworks, and iterative validation.
* Comfortable reading API docs, working with engineers on integration logic, and writing crisp PRDs.
* SQL fluency or strong data tool comfort — you build dashboards and interpret experiments, not just consume reports.
* 1–4 years of product management experience with clear ownership of strategy, execution, and measurable outcomes.



  





  





**Good to Have** 



* Prior experience in edtech or B2C.
* Hands\-on with MoEngage, WebEngage, Exotel, or similar stacks.
* Experience building or optimising lead scoring models, incentive systems, or performance management products.
* Exposure to automation platforms like n8n, Zapier, make.com, or internal iPaaS tools.

title: Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
As a valued employee of the British Council, you already help us deliver our mission to support peace and prosperity by building connections, understanding and trust between people in the UK and countries worldwide. For over 90 years we have shaped brighter futures through education, arts, culture, language, and creativity.


You are part of our organisation in over 200 countries and territories and where we are on the ground in more than 100 countries.


**We connect. We inspire.**

**Department: Talent Acquisition and Screening**  

**Contract Type: Fixed\-term \- 6 months**  

**Contract Hours: Full time, Monday to Friday**  

**Pay Band: 7**  

**Country/Location: Noida, India**

**The Role:** **Talent Acquisition Manager** will support Talent Acquisition’s (TA) mission to connect the British Council with great talent, matching skills to opportunities to enable the organisation to deliver its mission. We will do this by leveraging the British Council brand to attract and select talent that aligns with our values, and by delivering an equitable and inclusive candidate and employee experience.
  

Taking responsibility for delivering an exceptional end\-to\-end recruitment service (with a focus on specialist/managerial positions), the role will support the transition of Recruitment from its current transactional service to a strategic Talent Acquisition service, delivering global recruitment performance improvement. In addition, the role will support the drive to increase the appeal of the British Council as an employer of choice to individuals from underrepresented backgrounds.
  

  

**Accountabilities:**  

Deliver quality hires for the British Council ensuring all roles have an agreed talent acquisition (TA) plan which is delivered to a high standard (delivery focus is on specialist /strategic roles).
  

Recruit vacancies by deploying the end\-to\-end talent acquisition process; including, but not limited to, leading job briefing calls, sourcing, shortlisting, developing, and maintaining talent pools, advising on recruitment timelines and strategies, scheduling interviews and offer management.
  

Use data and intelligence effectively to advise on market, and accurately track and monitor performance of your TA pipeline, identifying trends and patterns, to achieve agreed performance metrics e.g., time to offer, candidate conversion etc., Generate and interpret data to inform decision\-making and make recommendations that inform future recruitment campaigns.
  

Maintain high standards of data quality to ensure accurate reporting, compliance, and audit.
  

Develop collaborative working relationships with hiring managers, People function colleagues and relevant teams through pro\-active partnership, to create a positive customer experience through all aspects of the TA process.
  

Provide mentoring and coaching to colleagues across the recruitment process to maintain performance standards and deliver a positive hiring experience.
  

Foster a culture of continuous improvement through sharing ideas and feedback, keeping up to date with external talent acquisition best practise and aligning to personal professional development.
  

Support diversity objectives, ensuring all attraction, sourcing and selection activity promotes equal opportunity, delivers a diverse talent pool, and improves the attraction of the British Council to under\-represented groups.
  

The main accountabilities of this role are described here. As our needs as an organisation change, we may need to make reasonable changes from time to time.
  

  

**Role specific knowledge and experience:**  

*Essential:*  

Proven experience of talent acquisition processes and a range of selection techniques.
  

Understanding of candidate sourcing techniques, including digital/social media and direct sourcing.
  

Understanding and experience of implementing attraction and selection activities that promote diversity in hiring.
  

Experience building, influencing, and maintaining relationships with stakeholders through clear and confident communication, including overcoming challenges and barriers.
  

Experience of delivering hiring to TA performance metrics and mechanisms, using data to inform decision\-making and drive continuous improvement including performance of attraction campaigns.
  

Driven and solutions\-orientated to provide an advisory level of service to stakeholders.
  

Experience of planning and organising, confidence in managing your own time effectively in a fast\-paced environment and responding to unforeseen priorities.
  

*Desirable:*  

Knowing the Market \- knowledgeable of regional employment marketplace and the British Council's customers and competitors.
  

Experience of working in a global, matrix organisation.
  

Knowledge of using SAP Success Factors Recruitment module or a similar Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
  

Relevant employment legislation.
  

Pre\-employment screening
  

  

**Role Specific Skills:**  

Data Literacy \- Data driven – grasps and uses data to make decisions and inform practice
  

Business Acumen \- Customer understanding\- Understands customer needs \& applies user\-centric principles
  

Digital Agility \- Digital aptitude \- Motivated to learn and experiment with digital ways of work
  

Execution Excellence –
   

Action orientation – Implements actionable and adaptive plans to achieve results
   

Interpersonal skills \- Achieves shared goals using effective interpersonal skills
  

  

**Closing Date: Applications will close at 23:59 IST on Saturday, 6 June 2026**

You must have the legal right to work in India at the time of application.
  

  

**Requirements:**  

Please note that candidates must have the pre\-existing, legal right to work in India.
  

Mobility / relocation / visa sponsoring support will not be provided.
  

  

British Council supports working in new ways such as hybrid working, subject to full approval by line management and conditional upon our ability to provide the appropriate level of service. This may not be appropriate for all roles but can be explored at interview.  



A connected and trusted UK in a more connected and trusted world.


**Equality, Diversity and Inclusion Statement**

We are committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and welcome applications from all sections of the community as we believe that a diverse workforce gives added depth to our work. The British Council is a Disability Confident Employer. The Disability Confident scheme helps challenge attitudes, increase understanding of disability and ensure staff are drawn from the widest possible pool of talent. We guarantee an interview for disabled applicants who meet the minimum role requirements. We welcome discussions about specific requirements or adjustments to enable participation and engagement in our work and activities.  



**Safeguarding Statement**

The British Council is committed to safeguarding children, young people and adults who we work with. We believe that all children and adults everywhere in the world deserve to live in safe environments and have the right to be protected from all forms of abuse, maltreatment and exploitation as set out in article 19, UNCRC (United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child) 1989\. Appointment to positions where there is direct involvement with vulnerable groups will be dependent on thorough checks being completed in line with legal requirements and with the British Council’s Safeguarding policies for Adults and Children.

title: Security Engineer (Web3 and Web2)
description:
Role \& Responsibilities
   

  

 We are seeking a Security Engineer I to join our team. The ideal candidate will be
   

  

 responsible for both Web3 and Web2 security paradigms, knowledge of Amazon Web
   

  

 Services (AWS), and proficiency in monitoring and alerting systems. This role involves
   

  

 ensuring the security of our digital assets, infrastructure, and applications.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Perform penetration testing of applications/products based on Web, Mobile, Web3 assets like Smart Contract, Bitcoin Script, etc.
* Plan and perform red team exercises in a variety of environments.
* Manage applications/products bug bounty program with validation and response mechanism for vulnerabilities submitted by external researchers.
* Continuous research on new attack vectors/techniques and their mitigations.
* Manage attack surface based on risk assessment for the business.
* Develop scripts, tools and methodologies to enhance security posture of the whole company and its applications/products.
* Manage continuous passive and active monitoring and alert systems such as Prometheus, Grafana, Wazuh, etc.
* Apply knowledge of AWS services to support the maintenance of secure cloud infrastructure. Deployment and management of security tools (open source and commercial)
* Clear communication for vulnerability reports and their remediation required.
* Work with cross\-functional teams to align and priorities remediation efforts.
* Work collaboratively/independently on unique or special assignments which may require specialized knowledge and/or experience.
* Comply with company, division and professional ethical standards.


 Ideal Candidate
   

  

* Strong Security Engineer Profile — Web3 \& Web2 \| Penetration Testing, Cloud Security \& Blockchain
* Mandatory (Experience) — Must have 4\+year of experience in a security engineering role or related position — covering both Web3 and Web2 security paradigms across application, infrastructure, and cloud security contexts.
* Mandatory (Penetration Testing \& Red Teaming) — Must have hands\-on experience performing penetration testing on Web, Mobile, and Web3 assets — including Smart Contracts and Bitcoin Scripts — and must have planned or executed red team exercises across varied environments.
* Mandatory (Application Security Knowledge) — Must have strong working knowledge of OWASP Top 10, SANS Top 25, NIST, MITRE ATT\&CK, and shift\-left security methodologies — with the ability to apply these in vulnerability identification and risk prioritisation.
* Mandatory (Infrastructure \& Networking Architecture) — Must have a strong understanding of application, infrastructure, and networking architecture — with the ability to assess attack surfaces holistically and manage risk across business assets.
* Mandatory (Monitoring \& Alerting) — Must be proficient in deploying and managing continuous monitoring and alerting systems — with direct exposure to tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Wazuh, or comparable security tooling.
* Mandatory (AWS \& Cloud Security) — Must have working familiarity with AWS services and basic cloud security concepts — with practical ability to support and maintain secure cloud infrastructure.
* Mandatory (Scripting \& Tooling) — Must be able to develop scripts, tools, and methodologies to enhance security posture — with working knowledge of at least one of Go, Rust, TypeScript, or Python.
* Mandatory (Blockchain Security Fundamentals) — Must have a foundational understanding of blockchain technologies and associated security considerations — covering smart contract security, Bitcoin script analysis, or related Web3 attack vectors.
* Mandatory (Education) — Must hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Mandatory (Company)\- Candidate must have prior experience working at a blockchain or Web3\-native product company.
* Preferred (Experience Depth) — More than 2 years in a security engineering role is a plus — reflecting deeper ownership of security programmes and broader exposure to advanced attack techniques.
* Preferred (Bug Bounty Program Management) — Experience managing a bug bounty program end\-to\-end — including vulnerability validation, researcher response coordination, and clear written communication of findings and remediation — is a meaningful plus.
* Preferred (Certifications) — Holding any one of C\-PENT, eJPT, PWPP, or GPEN is a plus as validated evidence of offensive security competency.
* Role Structure — Note: This is an Individual Contributor (IC) role initially — with the expectation of building and leading a security team as the function matures.


 Skills: infrastructure,cloud,web2,security,web3,cloud security,penetration testing,blockchain,aws

description:
**Role Title: AVP, Information Security Program Manager (L10\)**
**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a premier consumer financial services company delivering one of the industry’s most complete digitally enabled product suites. Our experience, expertise and scale encompass a broad spectrum of industries including digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoors, pet and more.
   

  

* We have recently been ranked \#2 among India’s Best Companies to Work for by Great Place to Work. We were among the Top 50 India’s Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All by GPTW and Top 25 among Best Workplaces in BFSI by GPTW. We have also been recognized by AmbitionBox Employee Choice Awards among the Top 20 Mid\-Sized Companies, ranked \#3 among Top Rated Companies for Women, and Top\-Rated Financial Services Companies.
* We provide best\-in\-class employee benefits and programs that cater to work\-life integration and overall well\-being
* We provide career advancement and upskilling opportunities for all to take up leadership roles


**Organizational Overview**
 The Information Security organization partners across Technology and the business to protect Synchrony’s customers, data, and platforms. The India InfoSec program function drives security culture, awareness, and engagement across sites, aligning local initiatives with enterprise security priorities and ensuring strong participation, measurable outcomes, and consistent execution.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 As AVP, Information Security Program Manager, you will lead the strategy, planning, and execution of India\-focused InfoSec engagement programs that strengthen security culture and community. This includes security hackathons/CTFs, university/student engagement, employee\-facing campaigns, and India hub/site\-level InfoSec initiatives. You will partner with Enterprise InfoSec leaders, India site leadership, universities, suppliers, and cross\-functional stakeholders to deliver high\-impact programs using Agile ways of working and tools such as Jira, Confluence, and SharePoint.
   

  

**Essential Responsibilities**
* Own the India InfoSec engagement roadmap and annual calendar; translate priorities into plans and measurable outcomes.
* Deliver year\-round security culture programs (communications, learning, contests, speaker sessions).
* Lead InfoSec hackathons/CTFs end\-to\-end: themes/objectives, problem statements (with SMEs/suppliers/universities), platform setup, participant onboarding, logistics, judging, recognition, and reporting/playbooks.
* Manage event budgets/forecasts, vendor coordination, and resource planning (as applicable).
* Ensure initiatives align with enterprise security policies, brand/communications standards, and legal/compliance requirements.
* Run a structured university engagement program (campus connects, guest lectures, workshops, mentorship, CTFs) and maintain key university partnerships.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition/HR and InfoSec leadership to translate hackathon outcomes into intern hiring recommendations and finalist tracking.
* Manage the InfoSec intern program: onboarding/orientation, check\-ins, milestone reviews, and mentor coordination.
* Define and track intern assignments/projects (goals, deliverables, timelines, success criteria) and maintain a centralized intern dashboard (joining/access/progress/ risks/outcomes).
* Coordinate internship closure (final demos, documentation handover, feedback/evaluations, and conversion recommendations where applicable) and drive continuous improvement of the pipeline.
* Drive Infosec India hub site initiatives (town halls, brown bags, community sessions, leadership visits).
* Coordinate across Enterprise InfoSec, Technology, Risk/Compliance, HR/L\&D, Communications, Legal, Procurement, Facilities, and business teams for scope, approvals, and delivery.
* Provide leadership dashboards, executive updates, and quarterly/annual impact summaries.
* Maintain program documentation in Confluence/SharePoint (charters, playbooks, comms plans, runbooks, asset libraries, retrospectives).
* Manage delivery in Jira (epics/stories, sprint planning, risk/issue/dependency tracking, status reporting).
* Ensure vendor governance (SOWs, deliverable quality, performance tracking, and required security controls).


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
* Bachelor’s degree and 5\+ years of experience in program/project management, including hackathons/CTFs, university engagement, and employee\-facing events in an enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing enterprise InfoSec programs and cross\-functional initiatives end\-to\-end (planning, execution, governance, stakeholder management).
* Strong working knowledge of Agile delivery practices and hands\-on expertise with Jira, Confluence, and SharePoint.
* Proven ability to drive complex programs with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and time\-sensitive deliverables.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including executive\-ready reporting and broad employee communications.
* Strong execution discipline: risk/issue management, dependency tracking, vendor coordination, and a continuous improvement mindset.


**Eligibility Criteria:** 
 Bachelor’s degree and 5\+ years of experience in program/project management, including hackathons/CTFs, university engagement, and employee\-facing events in an enterprise environment.
   

  

**Work Timings: 2 PM to 11 PM IST \- (This role requires the candidate to be based in Hyderabad location)**
 This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs)
   

  

**For Internal Applicants**

* Inform your manager and HRM before applying for any role on Workday
* Ensure that your professional profile is updated (fields such as education, prior experience, other skills) and it is mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format)
* Must not be any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal, PIP)
* L9\+ Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in current role and level are only eligible.
* Level 9\+ Employees can apply.

 We don’t believe in support roles. We believe in operators who run the systems that keep companies alive.

* Ownership over ego
* Experimentation over stagnation

* Clarity over complexity

 If you want to work with sharp teammates, solve real operational challenges, and grow faster in 2 years than most do in 5, you’ll feel at home here.
 



  
 



 Check more of what we do here: www.hirechore.com 
 



  
 



**🚀 The Role** 




 This isn’t a typical operations role.
 



  
 



 As a Strategy \& Operations Generalist at Chore (internally known as the Operations Specialist), you will run the back office for US startup founders keeping their HR, payroll, onboarding, compliance coordination, and recurring workflows running smoothly. You’ll be the person they rely on to keep the operational systems that power the business running smoothly.
 



  
 



 You’ll also own internal strategic initiatives that shape how Chore itself operates; designing systems, documentation, dashboards, and workflows that reduce chaos and scale excellence.
 



  
 



 If you love being the person everyone relies on to make the hard things run smoothly, this is your role.

**1\. Run the client’s back office end\-to\-end.** 




 You own their administrative engine: HR, payroll, onboarding/offboarding, compliance coordination, documentation, recurring workflows, dashboards, and urgent requests.

**2\. Deliver internal strategic initiatives that make Chore stronger.** 




 You lead cross\-functional projects: SOPs, systems, dashboards, operational improvements from scoping to execution to delivery.
 



  
 



 Success \= usable outputs adopted by teams, projects completed with minimal guidance, visible improvement to how Chore runs.
 



  
 



**3\. Proactively improve processes everywhere.** 




 You fix unclear workflows, rewrite messy documentation, streamline repeatable tasks, and propose smarter approaches \- even when it's not assigned.
 



  
 



 Success \= clearer systems, faster execution, fewer errors, and noticeable reduction in chaos.
 



  
 



**4\. Communicate with clarity and emotional intelligence.** 




 You provide clean TL;DRs, proactive updates, surfaced risks, and structured communication founders can rely on.
 



  
 



 Success \= no chasing for updates, early escalation, smooth collaboration, and trust built through clarity.
 



  
 



**5\. Operate with high ownership and sound judgment.** 




 You self\-manage, prioritize well, escalate thoughtfully, and take responsibility for outcomes.
 



  
 



 Success \= strong execution without reminders, calm handling of urgency, and work that stands on its own.

title: WLAN Performance testing
description:
**Company**
 Qualcomm India Private Limited
   

  

**Job Area**
 Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Systems Test Engineering
   

  

**General Summary**
 The WLAN Performance Test Engineer is responsible for validating the throughput, latency, RF performance of Wi\-Fi products and Power efficiency under various real\-world and lab conditions. The role ensures compliance with IEEE 802\.11 standards and identifies performance bottlenecks at PHY/MAC layers.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Performance Validation
* Conduct throughput testing using tools such as iPerf, IxChariot, octoScope, Spirent, or IXIA.
* Validate performance across different Wi\-Fi standards (802\.11ac/ax/be).
* Measure PHY data rate, throughput, Packet loss, Jitter, Latency, retransmission rate
* RF \& OTA (Over\-the\-Air) Testing
* Perform RF validation including RvR, RSSI, SNR,Adjacent channel interference
* Simulate customer field environment and test performance with different devices including iOS, Mac, Android, Windows
* Execute testing inside shield boxes or anechoic chambers.
* Load \& Scalability Testing
* Validate performance under high client density scenarios.
* Simulate concurrent traffic (VoIP, video streaming, web traffic).
* Interference Testing
* Test performance under co\-channel and adjacent channel interference.
* Evaluate performance in 2\.4GHz, 5GHz, and 6GHz bands.
* Automation \& Scripting
* Develop automation scripts using C Sharp, Python.
* Automate log collection, KPI extraction and triaging.
* Debug \& Root Cause Analysis
* Analyze packet captures (Wireshark).
* Interpret logs from AP, STA, and driver layers.
* Work with firmware and PHY teams for issue resolution.


**Required Skills \& Qualification**
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree
* Wireless Protocols: Strong understanding of IEEE 802\.11 standards (a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be), OFDM, MIMO, MU\-MIMO, QoS (WMM)
* Tools: Experience with IXIA / Spirent / Keysight test equipment, iPerf, Wireshark
* Networking: Knowledge of TCP/IP stack and preferred experience in Layer 2/Layer 3 networking.
* Analytical tools: Expertise in log analysis tools (Wireshark, tcpdump) for troubleshooting connectivity and performance issues
* Automation framework development experience


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4\+ years of Systems Test Engineering or related work experience.


 OR
   

  

 Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3\+ years of Systems Test Engineering or related work experience.
