title: Cyber Security Expert - Senior
description:
**Who We Are**
 Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey \- quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.
   

  

 Long Description
   

  

 Day\-to\-Day Responsibilities
   

  

 The role will include both recurring security assessment activities and project\-based penetration testing engagements, ensuring that internal and client\-facing systems are continuously evaluated against evolving threats, with findings properly tracked, reported, and resolved.
   

  

 Over time, this position is expected to grow into a more senior offensive security role, progressively contributing to red team operations, custom exploit development, security architecture reviews, and the definition of internal testing methodologies and standards.
   

  

 Who Are We Looking For
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines solid technical knowledge of offensive security with a methodical approach to vulnerability assessment and exploitation, together with the curiosity and drive to keep pace with an ever\-evolving threat landscape.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Plan, execute, and document penetration tests across web applications, internal networks, and external infrastructure
* Perform vulnerability assessments, security audits, and threat modeling activities
* Simulate real\-world attack scenarios including phishing campaigns, social engineering, and red team exercises
* Identify, exploit, and document security vulnerabilities, providing clear remediation guidance
* Produce detailed technical reports for both technical teams and non\-technical stakeholders
* Support remediation efforts by collaborating with development and infrastructure teams
* Stay current on emerging threats, CVEs, attack techniques, and security tooling
* Contribute to the improvement of internal security testing methodologies, tools, and playbooks
* Assist with security awareness initiatives and internal training activities
* Progressively take on more complex engagements, with a long\-term path toward senior red team or security architecture roles.
* Expected to work as per Italy timezone.


**Required Skills**
* Hands\-on experience with penetration testing of web applications, networks, and systems
* Good knowledge of common attack techniques (OWASP Top 10, MITRE ATT\&CK, privilege escalation, lateral movement, etc.)
* Proficiency with standard security tooling (Burp Suite, Nmap, Metasploit, Nessus, or similar)
* Ability to write clear, structured reports documenting findings, risk levels, and remediation steps
* Understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, firewalls, VPNs)
* Familiarity with Linux and Windows environments from both an attacker and defender perspective
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset
* Good communication skills in English, including the ability to explain technical findings to non\-technical audiences.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience with Active Directory attacks and privilege escalation in Windows environments
* Familiarity with cloud security testing (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Knowledge of scripting or automation for custom tooling (Python, Bash, PowerShell)
* Exposure to red team methodologies and adversary simulation frameworks
* Relevant certifications such as OSCP, CEH, eJPT, or equivalent
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, DORA).


**Experience**
* 5\+ years of relevant experience in penetration testing or offensive security
* A portfolio of CTF write\-ups, HackTheBox/TryHackMe profiles, bug bounty history, or examples of previous engagements are highly appreciated.


**Career Path**
 This role is intended as an entry point into a broader offensive security career. The selected candidate will initially focus on structured penetration testing engagements and vulnerability assessments, and will progressively be involved in more complex red team operations.
   

  

**Shape the evolution**
 We are on an exciting journey towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can\-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you'll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. With an empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career \- wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of 18,000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own.
   

  

 Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs.worldline.com
   

  

 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Security Reseacher (AI Security)
description:
Location: Bangalore \- Indraprastha, India
   

  

 Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
   

  

 Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
   

  

**Thales** 
 is looking for a curious and driven
 **Security Researcher** 
 to join our Threat Research Group in
 **India** 
 .
   

  

 Our team is at the forefront of the AI revolution, dedicated to securing the next generation of applications. We are currently on a mission to build and refine our
 **AI Firewall (AIFW)** 
 solution, ensuring that AI\-driven enterprises stay protected against emerging LLM\-based threats.
   

  

**What makes this position unique?**
* The Mission: You will be a core contributor to our AI security initiatives, specifically focused on analyzing how AI tools and evaluation frameworks can be both a target and a defense mechanism.
* The Collaboration: You will work in a tight feedback loop with our Data Science team, bridging the gap between raw security research and production\-grade machine learning models.
* The Impact: Your research won't just sit in a report; you will generate the actual prompts, datasets, and logic that our product uses to mitigate real\-world AI vulnerabilities.


**What will you do?**
* Analyze AI Ecosystems: Deep\-dive into AI tools, LLM frameworks, and AI evaluation suites to identify security gaps and operational strengths.
* Prompt Engineering \& Red Teaming: Design and test sophisticated prompts to evaluate model robustness and develop defensive "system prompts" for our AIFW product.
* Bridge Research \& Data Science: Translate security findings into actionable insights for our Data Science team to help train and refine detection algorithms.
* Vulnerability Research: Explore sophisticated automated attacks and "jailbreak" techniques to keep our defense layers one step ahead.


**What are we looking for?**
 A technical "engine" \- someone who is obsessed with how things work under the hood and is eager to apply security fundamentals to the world of Artificial Intelligence.
   

  

**Requirements:**
* A passion for Cybersecurity: Foundational knowledge in web application security, penetration testing, or cloud security.
* OWASP for AI Literacy: Solid understanding of the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications (e.g., Prompt Injection, Sensitive Information Disclosure, Model Denial of Service, and Insecure Output Handling).
* The "AI\-First" Approach: Familiarity with modern LLMs and experience evaluating them for safety, bias, or security vulnerabilities.
* Coding Proficiency: Strong JavaScript (essential) and Python (highly preferred for AI/Data Science collaboration).
* Data Literacy: Ability to work with datasets and AI evaluation tools; comfortable analyzing model outputs to improve product logic.
* Problem Solver: The ability to take a broad mission \- like "analyze this new AI evaluation tool" \- and break it down into a technical execution plan.
* Academic Background: B.Sc./M.Sc. in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience in security research.


 At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

description:
**Introduction**
 Welcome to Gallagher \- a global community of people who bring bold ideas, deep expertise, and a shared commitment to doing what’s right.
   

  

 We help clients navigate complexity with confidence by empowering businesses, communities, and individuals to thrive.
   

  

 At Gallagher, you’ll find more than a job; you’ll find a culture built on trust, driven by collaboration, and sustained by the belief that we’re better together. Experience a workplace where you’re encouraged to be yourself, supported to succeed, and inspired to keep learning. That’s what it means to live The Gallagher Way.
   

  

 Founded in 2006, the Gallagher Center of Excellence (GCoE) upholds the values of quality, innovation, and teamwork. With 10,000\+ professionals across five India locations, GCoE is where knowledge\-driven individuals make a significant impact and build rewarding, long\-term careers.
   

  

**Overview**
 Gallagher Center of Excellence is seeking a skilled web developer with a passion for creating seamless digital experiences. This position involves executing critical delivery tasks across multiple projects, ensuring the success of client deliveries, and maintaining consumer\-grade standards in all outputs. Preferred candidates should have prior experience in web development or related fields, along with a strong interest in technology, user experience, and problem\-solving.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will excel in task\-based work, collaborating within project teams using tools such as Jira boards, and engaging effectively with colleagues across various disciplines, including backend teams, project management, and client\-facing roles. They should demonstrate the ability to interpret instructions accurately, manage time efficiently, and consistently deliver high\-quality results on schedule while minimizing the need for revisions. Key attributes for this role include attention to detail, the ability to work independently, and confidence in managing multiple projects within a dynamic work environment.
   

  

**How You'll Make An Impact**
**Responsibilities:**
* JIRA Expertise: Proficient in analysing and interpreting JIRA tickets to deliver effective solutions, ensuring amendments are executed with precision, reliability, and adherence to project requirements.
* Content Management: Skilled in utilizing Content Management Systems (CMS) to efficiently add, update, and manage web page content, ensuring accuracy and alignment with organizational standards.
* Version Control: Extensive experience in leveraging GitHub for robust version control, including repository management, change tracking, team collaboration through pull requests and code reviews, resolving merge conflicts, and maintaining a well\-structured and organized codebase to support seamless project development and deployment.
* Website Configurations: Comprehensive understanding of website configurations, including but not limited to:
* Page planning and website architecture
* Content hierarchy and organization
* Document and asset uploads
* Quality Assurance: Adept at conducting thorough testing and validation of updates and changes to ensure optimal functionality and performance. Proactively identify, document, and report bugs or issues, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to implement effective resolutions.
* Accountability and Ownership: Demonstrates a strong sense of ownership by taking full accountability for tasks and projects, ensuring timely and precise delivery while maintaining high\-quality standards.
* Continuous Improvement: Proactively identifies opportunities for improvement in web solutions, offering innovative suggestions to enhance functionality, optimize performance, and elevate the overall user experience.


**Competencies:**
* Teamwork \& Interpersonal Skills: Effectively managing teams while fostering a collaborative environment that promotes teamwork and strong communication skills.
* Strategic Thinking: Develops and implements strategic communication plans. Thinks ahead and plans for future needs.
* Problem\-Solving: Identifies and resolves issues efficiently. Uses critical thinking to find effective solutions.
* Stakeholder Management: Manages relationships with key stakeholders. Ensures effective communication and collaboration.
* Project Management: Oversees multiple projects simultaneously. Ensures projects are completed on time and within budget.


**About You**
**Qualifications:**
* Minimum Required Degree: Bachelor of Computer Application, Bachelor of Computer Engineering.
* Preferred Degree: BCA , BE
* Certificate(s)/Special Training: Web/Software Development


**Required Skills and Experience:**
* Strong Communication: Comfortable reporting progress to colleagues across various disciplines.
* Time Management: Capable of independently completing tasks within prescribed deadlines.
* Analytical Thinking: Ability to comprehend complex content structures and apply them effectively.
* Quality Focus: Adherence to quality assurance standards and expectations.
* Task Execution: Proficient in interpreting instructions from Jira tickets and understanding project requirements.
* Problem\-Solving: Proactive in identifying and flagging issues to project team members as they arise.


**Additional Information**
**Compensation and benefits**
 On top of a competitive salary, great teams and exciting career opportunities, we also offer a wide range of benefits.
   

  

 Below are the
 **minimum core benefits** 
 you’ll get, depending on your job level, these benefits may improve:
   

  

* Medical Insurance and Parental Medical Insurance
* Accidental Insurance and Life Insurance
* Retirals \- Employee Gratuity, Future Service Gratuity benefit \- Group Term Life, Employee Provident Fund, National Pension Scheme
* Flexi Benefits Plan – Tax Savings Plans
* Annual Leave/ Maternity \& Paternity Leave/ Additional paid ML, Mental Health Day


**Other** 
**benefits include:**
* Employee Wellness Programs
* Training programs
* And more..


**We value inclusion and diversity**
 Inclusion and diversity (I\&D) is a core part of our business, and it’s embedded into the fabric of our organization. For more than 95 years, Gallagher has led with a commitment to sustainability and to support the communities where we live and work.
   

  

 Gallagher embraces our employees’ diverse identities, experiences and talents, allowing us to better serve our clients and communities. We see inclusion as a conscious commitment and diversity as a vital strength. By embracing diversity in all its forms, we live out The Gallagher Way to its fullest.
   

  

 Equal employment opportunity will be extended in all aspects of the employer\-employee relationship, including, but not limited to, recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, transfer, demotion, compensation, benefits, layoff, and termination.

title: Android Developer
description:
**About Bureau** 




  





 Bureau is a unified risk decisioning platform for Compliance, Fraud, and Transaction risks. Our platform is a single decision\-making engine, powered by a 1 billion\+ identity knowledge graph. Over 150 Banks, fintechs, retailers, and digital platforms use Bureau to verify identities faster and stop fraud earlier globally.
 



  





 Bureau has raised $50M\+ from renowned Silicon Valley and global investors including Sorenson Capital and PayPal Ventures and is expanding rapidly from APAC to Americas, Europe, and beyond.
 



  





**Why Bureau?** 




  





 Bureau is building the infrastructure that makes digital identities and transactions safe and trustworthy for billions of people. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is real.
 



  





 We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, build systems from scratch, and care deeply about turning strategy into execution. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won't be your place. If you want to shape how a scaling global company operates—keep reading.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We're looking for an experienced Android Engineer to join our Fraud Prevention Team, someone who thrives at building scalable SDKs, mobile infrastructure components, and tooling that empowers multiple product teams. If you're excited by mobile architecture, developer experience, and driving consistency across apps, this role is for you.
 



  





 You'll be a key player in crafting SDKs and reusable components across Android and Flutter ecosystems, with an emphasis on performance, security, and maintainability.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Design, build, and maintain Android SDKs, libraries, and reusable platform modules.
* Collaborate with multiple product teams to extract repeatable patterns and abstract them into common tools.
* Build and maintain cross\-platform components in Flutter, ensuring alignment across iOS and Android.
* Optimize SDKs for performance, memory usage, battery efficiency, and reliability.
* Apply OOP principles, SOLID practices, and clean architecture patterns (MVVM/MVI).
* Implement robust error handling, thread management, and lifecycle\-aware components.
* Ensure high observability by adding instrumentation and logging.
* Work closely with QA, CI/CD, and DevOps for seamless releases and SDK delivery.
* Stay ahead of Android platform updates and proactively integrate platform changes.



  





**Requirements:** 




  




* 1\-3 years of professional Android development experience.
* Proficiency in Kotlin and Java with strong understanding of Android SDK internals.
* Solid foundation in Object\-Oriented Programming, design patterns, and clean code principles.
* Experience with Gradle, multi\-module architectures, and build optimizations.
* Proven track record of building, maintaining, and distributing Android SDKs used across multiple apps.
* Good understanding of app lifecycle, background tasks, concurrency, and memory management.
* Familiarity with Flutter and Dart, or willingness to work in cross\-platform environments.
* Experience with system\-level debugging using tools like Android Profiler, LeakCanary, StrictMode, etc.
* Comfortable with RESTFul APIs, offline storage, Proguard/R8, SSL pinning, and secure coding practices.
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, test automation, and release versioning.



  





**Good to Have:** 




  




* Experience writing platform channels in Flutter and integrating native modules.
* Contributions to open\-source Android/Flutter projects.
* Understanding of Maven, internal artifact management, and semantic versioning.
* Exposure to low\-level system APIs, hardware interactions, or custom device integrations.



  





**Our Culture** 



* We hire self\-motivated people and get out of their way
* We value performance, not hours worked
* Speed, ownership, and impact matter most



  





**Compensation** 



* Competitive salary \+ potential equity
* Health benefits, flexible PTO, learning budget

**Job Responsibilities – Branch Manager**

* **Oversee Branch Operations:** Ensure the smooth functioning of daily operations across all areas including loan disbursement, customer service, compliance and branch administration.
* **Resource Management:** Ensure the branch is adequately staffed and resources are efficiently allocated to meet customer needs and business objectives.
* **Achieve Sales Targets:** Set and drive branch\-specific targets for gold loans, interest collections, investments, insurance, tourism etc
* **Business Development:** Lead efforts to generate new business by identifying potential customers, forming partnerships, and promoting company’s financial products.
* **Market Expansion:** Implement strategies to expand the branch’s reach and market share, including identifying untapped customer segments or geographical areas.
* **Team Supervision:** Lead and manage the branch team, including junior officers, ABH, and other support functions.
* **Training \& Development:** Ensure the team is well\-trained on product offerings, sales techniques, compliance regulations, and customer service skills.
* **Performance Monitoring:** Set performance goals for individual team members and conduct performance reviews. Provide guidance and mentorship to improve team performance.
* **Motivation \& Retention:** Foster a positive work environment, motivate the team, and ensure high employee morale to reduce attrition and improve productivity.
* **Client Engagement:** Build and nurture strong relationships with key customers, ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction and retention.
* **Customer Issue Resolution:** Resolve complex customer issues or complaints promptly and professionally, ensuring that service levels are consistently met.
* **Regulatory Compliance:** Ensure the branch is in full compliance with all regulatory guidelines and internal policies, including the Central Registrar of Cooperative Societies (CRCS), the Multi\-State Cooperative Societies Act, 2002 and the Multi\-State Cooperative Societies Rules, 2002\.
* **Audit and Reporting:** Ensure timely and accurate reporting of branch activities to the corporate office and regulatory bodies, including audit compliance and KYC/AML processes.
* **Credit Portfolio Management:** Monitor the health of the branch’s loan portfolio, ensuring timely interest collections and minimizing defaults or NPAs (Non\-Performing Assets).
* **Branch Promotion:** Lead marketing efforts to enhance the branch’s visibility in the market, including organizing events, promoting products, and engaging with local businesses.
* **Marketing Strategy:** Develop and implement local marketing strategies to promote the Company’s products, aligning with corporate branding and product offerings.
* **Internal Collaboration:** Work closely with other departments (e.g., loans, accounts, operations, compliance, and HR) to ensure alignment and smooth functioning across the organization.
* **Crisis Management:** In case of any operational disruptions or crises, such as a system outage, customer complaints, or fraud\-related incidents, the Branch Head is responsible for managing the response and resolution.

**Role Title: AVP, Information Security Program Manager (L10\)**


**Company Overview:**

Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a premier consumer financial services company delivering one of the industry’s most complete digitally enabled product suites. Our experience, expertise and scale encompass a broad spectrum of industries including digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoors, pet and more.


* We have recently been ranked \#2 among India’s Best Companies to Work for by Great Place to Work. We were among the Top 50 India’s Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All by GPTW and Top 25 among Best Workplaces in BFSI by GPTW. We have also been recognized by AmbitionBox Employee Choice Awards among the Top 20 Mid\-Sized Companies, ranked \#3 among Top Rated Companies for Women, and Top\-Rated Financial Services Companies.

* We provide career advancement and upskilling opportunities for all to take up leadership roles

**Organizational Overview:**

The Information Security organization partners across Technology and the business to protect Synchrony’s customers, data, and platforms. The India InfoSec program function drives security culture, awareness, and engagement across sites, aligning local initiatives with enterprise security priorities and ensuring strong participation, measurable outcomes, and consistent execution.


**Role Summary/Purpose:**

As AVP, Information Security Program Manager, you will lead the strategy, planning, and execution of India\-focused InfoSec engagement programs that strengthen security culture and community. This includes security hackathons/CTFs, university/student engagement, employee\-facing campaigns, and India hub/site\-level InfoSec initiatives. You will partner with Enterprise InfoSec leaders, India site leadership, universities, suppliers, and cross\-functional stakeholders to deliver high\-impact programs using Agile ways of working and tools such as Jira, Confluence, and SharePoint.


**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Own the India InfoSec engagement roadmap and annual calendar; translate priorities into plans and measurable outcomes.
* Deliver year\-round security culture programs (communications, learning, contests, speaker sessions).
* Lead InfoSec hackathons/CTFs end\-to\-end: themes/objectives, problem statements (with SMEs/suppliers/universities), platform setup, participant onboarding, logistics, judging, recognition, and reporting/playbooks.
* Manage event budgets/forecasts, vendor coordination, and resource planning (as applicable).
* Ensure initiatives align with enterprise security policies, brand/communications standards, and legal/compliance requirements.
* Run a structured university engagement program (campus connects, guest lectures, workshops, mentorship, CTFs) and maintain key university partnerships.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition/HR and InfoSec leadership to translate hackathon outcomes into intern hiring recommendations and finalist tracking.
* Manage the InfoSec intern program: onboarding/orientation, check\-ins, milestone reviews, and mentor coordination.
* Define and track intern assignments/projects (goals, deliverables, timelines, success criteria) and maintain a centralized intern dashboard (joining/access/progress/ risks/outcomes).
* Coordinate internship closure (final demos, documentation handover, feedback/evaluations, and conversion recommendations where applicable) and drive continuous improvement of the pipeline.
* Drive Infosec India hub site initiatives (town halls, brown bags, community sessions, leadership visits).
* Coordinate across Enterprise InfoSec, Technology, Risk/Compliance, HR/L\&D, Communications, Legal, Procurement, Facilities, and business teams for scope, approvals, and delivery.
* Provide leadership dashboards, executive updates, and quarterly/annual impact summaries.
* Maintain program documentation in Confluence/SharePoint (charters, playbooks, comms plans, runbooks, asset libraries, retrospectives).
* Manage delivery in Jira (epics/stories, sprint planning, risk/issue/dependency tracking, status reporting).
* Ensure vendor governance (SOWs, deliverable quality, performance tracking, and required security controls).

**Required Skills/Knowledge:**

* Bachelor’s degree and 5\+ years of experience in program/project management, including hackathons/CTFs, university engagement, and employee\-facing events in an enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing enterprise InfoSec programs and cross\-functional initiatives end\-to\-end (planning, execution, governance, stakeholder management).
* Strong working knowledge of Agile delivery practices and hands\-on expertise with Jira, Confluence, and SharePoint.
* Proven ability to drive complex programs with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and time\-sensitive deliverables.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including executive\-ready reporting and broad employee communications.
* Strong execution discipline: risk/issue management, dependency tracking, vendor coordination, and a continuous improvement mindset.

**Eligibility Criteria:** Bachelor’s degree and 5\+ years of experience in program/project management, including hackathons/CTFs, university engagement, and employee\-facing events in an enterprise environment.


**Work Timings: 2 PM to 11 PM IST \- (This role requires the candidate to be based in Hyderabad location)**


This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). Job Summary\-

Vishram Management Group (VMG) is seeking a highly sophisticated, purely independent, and execution\-focused Senior HR Manager. This is not a traditional HR role; it is a full\-ownership mandate for an HR architect who can build, scale, and discipline a high\-performance organization from scratch.

Operating across multiple diverse business verticals—including Study Abroad, Work Abroad, (VIS) as well as Retail, QSR (Quick Service Restaurants), and Backend Operations (VMG)—you will design the infrastructure that governs our talent lifecycle. You will be fully empowered to operate autonomously, implementing systems, driving accountability, and optimizing human capital ROI without requiring day\-to\-day supervision.

Responsibilities

1\. Absolute HR Ownership \& Governance

* Take end\-to\-end strategic and operational accountability for the entire HR lifecycle across both entities (VIS \& VMG).
* Autonomously manage talent acquisition, onboarding, employee relations, payroll compliance, performance evaluations, and structured offboarding.
* Serve as the ultimate point of escalation for internal conflicts, disciplinary actions, and labor compliance.

2\. Strategic Talent Acquisition \& Team Architecture

* Partner with business unit heads to accurately forecast talent requirements based on business needs and clear ROI metrics, avoiding headcount inflation.
* Design, implement, and scale aggressive sourcing and hiring strategies tailored for both high\-volume roles (Sales, QSR, Retail) and highly specialized corporate roles.
* Standardize rigorous interview frameworks to assess candidate capability, culture alignment, and emotional resilience.

3\. HR Tech Infrastructure, Automation \& Analytics

* Serve as the internal Product Owner for the entire HR tech stack. Map, configure, and maintain automated workflows to eliminate manual intervention.
* Implement productivity tracking systems, time\-tracking tools, and CRM alignments to monitor remote employee output seamlessly.
* Generate weekly data\-driven reports analyzing time\-to\-hire, cost\-per\-hire, employee turnover, and individual productivity metrics.

4\. High\-Performance Management \& Accountability

* Design and implement comprehensive Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) for every tier of the organization.
* Establish a culture of strict meritocracy and accountability.
* Concurrently manage underperformance with professional objectivity—executing structured Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs), delivering formal warnings, and confidently making timely termination decisions when necessary.

5\. SOP Development \& Process Standardization

* Draft, codify, and enforce standard operating procedures (SOPs) for every HR process.
* Build a comprehensive, digitized employee handbook and institutionalize onboarding pathways that ensure new hires are productive within their first week.

6\. Cost Optimization \& Compensation Architecture

* Continuously audit and optimize compensation structures, incentives, and benefit plans to maximize organizational ROI.
* Monitor resource utilization to ensure maximum business output per employee, mitigating overhead leakages.

Candidate Requirements

Experience \& Qualifications

* 8\+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 3\+ years in a Talent Leadership, HR Manager, or Head of HR capacity.
* Proven track record of scaling remote or cross\-functional teams from the ground up, specifically spanning diverse industries like Sales, EdTech/Immigration, Retail, or Operations.
* Demonstrated experience handling high\-volume recruitment without compromising on talent quality.

Core Competencies \& Traits

* High Ownership Mindset: An entrepreneurial operator who looks at the business as their own and actively seeks solutions rather than pointing out problems.
* Execution\-Obsessed: Strong preference for action and measurable outcomes over theoretical strategies.
* Radical Candor: Comfortable navigating difficult conversations, managing conflict, and executing necessary exit strategies with absolute professionalism and legal compliance.
* Process\-Driven: Exceptional attention to detail with an inherent need to organize workflows, build checklists, and leave zero room for operational oversights.

Mandatory Tool Requirements (Non\-Negotiable)

* This role requires an HR leader who is also a systems administrator. We are a digital\-first organization built on the Zoho Ecosystem. You must possess advanced, hands\-on administrative configuration knowledge of:

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**Description**


**Who is USP?**


The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.


At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.


USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.


**Brief Job Overview**


Talent Acquisition Specialist is a key mission enabler at USP and we’re seeking an exceptional recruiter to join our team. Our new team member will lead their hiring managers through the full lifecycle of recruiting for a variety of professional, technical, scientific, and administrative positions. Primary responsibilities involve deep partnership and with business leaders and hiring managers to effectively source, recruit, evaluate, interview, and select top Acquisition/HR projects that will strengthen USP offerings and branding as an employer of choice.


**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**


As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.

title: Jr. QC Engineer (Fresher Apply)
description:
* **Ensuring Product Quality:**QC Engineers are responsible for ensuring that products meet specified quality standards and customer expectations throughout the manufacturing process.
* **Developing and Implementing Quality Control Systems:**They play a crucial role in developing and implementing quality control systems, procedures, and processes to ensure consistency and adherence to standards.
* **Conducting Inspections and Testing:**QC Engineers conduct thorough inspections and tests on raw materials, components, and finished products to identify any defects or deviations from specifications.
* **Analyzing Data and Identifying Issues:**They analyze data from inspections and tests to identify trends, root causes of quality problems, and areas for improvement.
* **Implementing Corrective and Preventive Actions:**QC Engineers work with cross\-functional teams to implement corrective and preventive actions to address identified quality issues and prevent recurrence.
* **Documentation and Reporting:**They maintain detailed records of inspections, tests, and corrective actions, and prepare reports to document quality performance and identify areas for improvement.
* **Collaborating with Teams:**QC Engineers collaborate with various departments, including production, engineering, and supply chain, to ensure that quality standards are met throughout the entire process.
* **Staying Updated:**They stay current with industry trends, new technologies, and regulatory requirements related to quality control to continuously improve processes and procedures.

title: Business Development Executive (BDE)
description:
About ARCHLE Labs

ARCHLE Labs – Advanced Research Centre for Health and Life Science Engineering is a health\-tech R\&D startup based in Bangalore. We are building science and engineering\-driven healthcare solutions that improve access, affordability, and quality of care.

Our vision is simple:

To make quality healthcare accessible to everyone.

India needs healthcare solutions that are practical, scalable, and accessible across diverse communities. This requires professionals who can support systems, coordinate teams, manage operations, and help bring innovation to the people who need it most.

At ARCHLE Labs, your work will not be limited to routine office tasks. You will be part of a mission\-driven team working to build products, systems, and operations that support the future of public health.

About the Role

We are looking for a Sales Executive who will be responsible for selling hospital software solutions and medical devices to hospitals, clinics, nursing homes, diagnostic centres, and healthcare institutions.

The role involves identifying potential customers, visiting hospitals and clinics, understanding their requirements, presenting ARCHLE Labs’ healthcare solutions, conducting product demonstrations, following up with prospects, and closing sales.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable with field sales, customer communication, product explanation, lead generation, and meeting healthcare decision\-makers such as doctors, clinic owners, hospital administrators, purchase managers, and biomedical teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and generate leads from hospitals, clinics, nursing homes, diagnostic centres, and healthcare providers.
* Visit hospitals and clinics to present hospital software solutions and medical devices.
* Meet doctors, clinic owners, hospital administrators, biomedical engineers, purchase managers, and other key decision\-makers.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable healthcare software or device solutions.
* Conduct product demos and explain features, benefits, pricing, and use cases clearly.
* Follow up with leads and convert prospects into customers.
* Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with hospitals, clinics, and healthcare professionals.
* Coordinate with internal teams for product demos, quotations, proposals, installation, training, and after\-sales support.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, customer visits, follow\-ups, sales pipeline, and closures.
* Track customer interactions using CRM tools, Excel, Google Sheets, or internal sales systems.
* Collect market feedback, competitor information, and customer requirements.
* Support payment follow\-ups and customer onboarding when required.

Required Skills

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to sell to hospitals, clinics, doctors, and healthcare institutions.
* Good presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.
* Confidence to conduct field visits and meet senior decision\-makers.
* Basic understanding of healthcare, hospital workflows, medical devices, or software products.
* Ability to explain technical products in a simple and convincing manner.
* Self\-motivated, disciplined, target\-oriented, and willing to travel.
* Basic knowledge of Excel, Google Sheets, CRM tools, or sales tracking systems.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Science, Pharmacy, Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare Management, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in B2B sales, healthcare sales, hospital software sales, medical device sales, pharma sales, or institutional sales preferred.
* Freshers with strong communication skills and willingness to work in field sales may also apply.
* Prior experience selling to hospitals, clinics, doctors, or healthcare institutions will be an added advantage.

Preferred Experience

* Experience in HMIS sales or hospital management software sales.
* Experience selling healthcare software to hospitals, clinics, nursing homes, or diagnostic centres.
* Understanding of hospital workflows such as registration, appointment management, billing, pharmacy, lab, EMR/EHR, patient records, and reporting.
* Medical device or diagnostic equipment sales experience will be an added advantage.
* Existing network with hospitals, clinics, doctors, administrators, or purchase departments.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work in a fast\-growing health\-tech R\&D startup.
* Exposure to healthcare software, medical devices, and public health innovation.
* Performance\-based incentives and growth opportunities.
* ESOPs for eligible team members based on role, performance, and long\-term contribution.
* Product training and sales support.
* Career growth in healthcare technology, HMIS, and medical device sales.
* Mission\-driven work environment focused on improving healthcare access.

 Join our Fleet Operations Engineering organization — the people responsible for designing, building, and operating the large\-scale Linux and storage infrastructure that powers Apple's services at extraordinary scale.  You will deploy and maintain large fleets of Linux systems, configure and provision SAN storage infrastructure, and develop automation tooling that drives reliability and reduces toil across the organization. You'll partner closely with developers, DBAs, network engineers, and EPMs to build the environments that make Apple's products possible — championing self\-service, security, and engineering excellence every step of the way.

* Proficiency in Bash shell scripting for automation, task management, and system operations
* Solid understanding of Linux fundamentals: file systems, process management, user and group administration, and package management
* Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language such as Python, Go, Ruby, Swift, or Java
* Working knowledge of networking concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and basic firewall configuration, as they relate to storage and systems infrastructure
* Familiarity with Oracle software stack and/or NoSQL databases

**Preferred Qualifications**

**Role Overview**

Your role involves expert\-level knowledge in managing complex enterprise routing and switching, designing and maintaining enterprise Wireless Infrastructure (Cisco Meraki), configuring enterprise\-grade firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto), and integrating hybrid cloud solutions. title: Trainer - Tailoring
description:
**Trainer – Tailoring (Woven \& Knits)**

Department

Training / Production

Reporting To

Training Manager / Unit HR Manager / Production Manager

Location

Garment Factory / Training Centre

Job Purpose

To train fresher candidates and existing employees in garment stitching operations for both woven and knitted garments, ensuring improvement in sewing skills, quality standards, productivity, discipline, and line readiness as per factory requirements.

Key ResponsibilitiesTraining \& Skill Development

* Provide practical and theoretical training to fresher tailors and helper trainees.
* Train operators in handling sewing machines for woven and knitted garment production.
* Conduct training on various sewing operations such as:
* Single needle
* Overlock
* Flatlock
* Feed\-off\-arm
* Buttonhole
* Bartack
* Kansai and other special machines
* Teach garment construction methods for shirts, pants, t\-shirts, leggings, innerwear, and other products.
* Explain sewing techniques, seam quality, measurement accuracy, and finishing standards.
* Conduct skill upgradation training for existing tailors to improve efficiency and multi\-skilling.

Production \& Quality Support

* Support production departments by supplying trained operators to sewing lines.
* Monitor trainee performance on productivity and quality parameters.
* Reduce alteration and rejection percentage through proper training.
* Train employees on SOPs, operation bulletins, safety procedures, and quality standards.
* Coordinate with QA and Production teams for training requirements.

Machine Handling \& Maintenance

* Train employees on safe handling of sewing machines and attachments.
* Guide trainees on basic machine maintenance and troubleshooting.
* Coordinate with mechanics for machine readiness during training sessions.

Assessment \& Documentation

* Conduct skill assessments and operator evaluations periodically.
* Maintain trainee attendance, skill matrix, and training records.
* Prepare daily/weekly/monthly training reports.
* Identify slow learners and provide additional coaching.

Behavioral \& Workplace Training

* Educate trainees on factory discipline, attendance, housekeeping, and safety practices.
* Motivate trainees for retention and continuous improvement.
* Ensure proper workplace behavior and teamwork among trainees.

Eligibility CriteriaEducational Qualification

* ITI / Diploma in Garment Technology / Fashion Technology preferred.
* Minimum SSLC/HSC with strong garment industry experience can also be considered.

Experience

* 5 to 10 years experience in garment sewing operations.
* Minimum 2 to 3 years experience as Tailoring Trainer / Line Trainer preferred.
* Strong knowledge in both woven and knitted garment manufacturing.

Required Skills

* Excellent tailoring and sewing knowledge.
* Strong practical training capability.
* Knowledge of industrial sewing machines.
* Good communication and demonstration skills.
* Ability to handle fresher candidates effectively.
* Knowledge of garment quality standards and productivity improvement.
* Basic reporting and documentation skills.

Key Performance Indicators (KPI)

* Number of trainees converted into operators.
* Training completion percentage.
* Productivity achievement of trained operators.
* Reduction in rejection and alteration percentage.
* Retention of trained employees.
* Multi\-skill development achievement.

Working Conditions

* Factory and training centre environment.
* Standing and practical demonstration work involved.
* May support production during peak requirements.

Additional Preference

* Candidates with experience in rural tailoring training, apprenticeship programs, or government skill development projects will be preferred.

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

title: Senior MERN Stack Developer
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced **MERN Stack Developer** with strong hands\-on expertise in MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js. The ideal candidate should be capable of independently developing, maintaining, and optimizing full\-stack web applications.

This role requires someone who has solid knowledge across the entire MERN stack, with a

stronger preference for candidates who are highly skilled in backend development, API

architecture, database design, and application performance.

Experience with Next.js and basic deployment/server handling will be considered an added

advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Full Stack Development**

● Develop scalable and maintainable web applications using MongoDB, Express.js,React.js, and Node.js.

● Build complete end\-to\-end features from frontend UI to backend APIs and database integration.

● Write clean, reusable, modular, and well\-structured code.

● Understand business requirements and convert them into technical solutions.

● Take ownership of assigned modules and deliver them independently.

**Backend Development**

● Design and develop robust backend APIs using Node.js and Express.js.

● Implement business logic, middleware, validations, authentication, and authorization.

● Create secure and optimized REST APIs with proper request/response structures.

● Handle error management, logging, API performance, and backend scalability.

● Work with JWT, role\-based access control, file uploads, third\-party APIs, and webhooks.

● Maintain clean backend architecture using controllers, services, routes, models, and utilities.

**Database Management**

● Design and maintain MongoDB schemas and data models.

● Work with relationships, aggregations, indexing, and query optimization.

● Ensure data consistency, performance, and proper database structure.

● Debug and optimize slow queries and database\-related issues.

**Frontend Development**

● Build responsive and user\-friendly interfaces using React.js.

● Create reusable components, hooks, layouts, and frontend utilities.

● Integrate APIs with proper loading states, error handling, validations, and edge\-case handling.

● Manage frontend state using Redux, Zustand, Context API, or other project\-required tools.

● Optimize frontend performance by reducing unnecessary re\-renders and improving UI flow.

**API Integration \& Authentication**

● Integrate frontend screens with backend APIs using proper data mapping.

● Implement login, registration, token handling, protected routes, and session

management.

● Handle API errors, empty states, validation messages, and permission\-based flows.

**Performance \& Code Quality**

● Optimize application performance on both frontend and backend.

● Improve API response time, database queries, frontend rendering, and bundle size.

● Follow coding standards, best practices, and proper Git workflow.

● Review, debug, refactor, and improve existing code when required.

**Third\-Party Integrations**

● Integrate payment gateways, email/SMS services, cloud storage, analytics tools, and

external APIs.

● Handle webhook flows, sandbox/production configurations, and secure API key

management.

**Deployment \& Environment Handling**

● Prepare frontend and backend builds for development, staging, and production

environments.

● Manage environment variables and configuration files securely.

● Basic understanding of deployment on VPS/cloud platforms will be an added advantage.

● Validate deployments with functional testing and issue resolution.

**Technical Leadership \& Team Guidance**

● Guide junior and mid\-level developers in technical implementation, code structure, and

best practices.

● Review code and provide constructive feedback to maintain code quality.

● Help developers resolve technical blockers and debugging issues.

● Suggest better approaches for architecture, API design, database structure, and

frontend implementation.

● Ensure the team follows proper coding standards, Git workflow, and project structure.

● Support the Team Lead/Project Manager in technical planning, estimation, and feasibility

analysis.

● Share knowledge with the team and help improve overall development practices.

● Take ownership of complex modules and support other developers in delivering their

assigned tasks.

**Next.js Knowledge \- Added Advantage**

● Experience with Next.js will be preferred.

● Understanding of SSR, SSG, routing, API routes, middleware, and performance

optimization in Next.js will be a plus.

**Required Skills**

● Strong hands\-on experience with MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js.

● Good command over backend development using Node.js and Express.js.

● Strong understanding of REST API development and integration.

● Experience with MongoDB schema design, aggregation, indexing, and optimization.

● Good knowledge of React.js components, hooks, state management, and UI integration.

● Experience with authentication, authorization, JWT, middleware, and protected routes.

● Ability to write clean, scalable, and maintainable code.

● Good debugging and problem\-solving skills.

● Experience with Git and standard development workflows.

● Ability to work independently on assigned modules.

**Preferred / Added Advantage Skills**

● Experience with Next.js.

● Basic deployment knowledge on VPS, cloud servers, or platforms like Hostinger, AWS,

DigitalOcean, Vercel, or similar.

● Knowledge of Redis, caching, queues, or background jobs.

● Experience with payment gateways, webhooks, and third\-party integrations.

● Familiarity with Docker or CI/CD basics.

● Understanding of application security and performance optimization.

**Experience Level**

● Looking for a mid\-level to senior\-level MERN Stack Developer.

● Candidate should not be a fresher.

● Candidate must have practical project experience and should be able to handle full\-stack

development independently.

● Strong backend experience will be highly preferred.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate should be someone who:

● Has strong practical experience in the complete MERN stack.

● Can independently handle frontend, backend, database, and API integration.

● Is stronger on backend development but comfortable working across the full stack.

● Can understand requirements, suggest technical solutions, and take ownership.

● Writes clean, structured, and scalable code.

● Has problem\-solving ability beyond basic implementation.

● Has additional exposure to Next.js and deployment workflows.

Pay: ₹28,000\.00 \- ₹42,000\.00 per month

description:

**Location:** 
 Mumbai, Andheri East (In\-Office) \|
 **Experience:** 
 0–3 years
 



  





 About Pepper
 



  





 Pepper is building an AI\-powered content and SEO growth platform, serving 2,500\+ global brands with 150,000\+ content creators. We're not just using AI—we're embedding it into everything we do. And we need builders to make that happen.
 



 The Role
 



  





**We need AI tinkerers who ship.** 




  





 You'll embed directly with teams across Pepper—Sales, Marketing, Content, Ops, Product—and do one thing:
 **find friction, build micro apps, automate the boring stuff.** 




 No 6\-month roadmaps. No endless PRDs. You see a problem Monday, you ship a working prototype by Wednesday.
 



  





 You'll report directly into the founder and functional leaders. Full access to data, systems, and context. Zero bureaucracy. Maximum velocity.
 



  





 What You'll Do
 



  




* **Sit with every team.** 
 Understand their workflows, pain points, and where they waste time.
* **Spot automation opportunities.** 
 If a human is doing something repetitive, your job is to make an AI do it.
* **Build micro apps fast.** 
 Internal tools, automations, LLM\-powered workflows, dashboards—whatever solves the problem.
* **Ship working prototypes.** 
 Not decks. Not wireframes. Working products.
* **Iterate relentlessly.** 
 Deploy, get feedback, improve, redeploy. Speed \> perfection.



  





 Who This Is For
 



  




* You've
 **built something real with LLMs** 
 —not just played with ChatGPT, but actually shipped a tool, bot, app, or workflow that works
* You're
 **obsessed with AI** 
 and spend your weekends trying new models, frameworks, and tools
* You
 **think in use\-cases** 
 —you see inefficiency and immediately imagine the solution
* You're
 **technical enough to build** 
 , but business\-minded enough to know what's worth building
* You have
 **high hustle, low ego** 
 —you'll sit with a sales rep at 9 AM and debug code at 9 PM
* You want
 **hands\-on experience** 
 in a fast\-scaling startup, not a rotational "AI program" at a big company



  





 What You Bring
 



  




* **0–3 years experience** 
 —or even fresher if you've built legit stuff on your own
* Hands\-on experience with
 **LLMs, APIs, prompt engineering, Python, no\-code/low\-code tools**
* A portfolio of
 **things you've shipped** 
 —side projects, hacks, tools, bots, automations. Show us.
* Ability to learn fast, context\-switch faster, and ship fastest
* **Mumbai\-based or willing to relocate.** 
 This is in\-office, Andheri East. Non\-negotiable.



  





 Why This Role Is Different
 



  





 You're not joining an "AI team" that debates frameworks for 6 months. You're joining as a
 **builder with a mandate to ship** 
 —directly plugged into leadership, with access to everything you need.
 



 Real problems. Real teams. Real impact. Fast.
 



  





 If you want to compress 5 years of learning into 1—this is it.
 



  





 To Apply
 



  





 No resume fluff. Tell us:
 


1. **One thing you've built with AI** 
 —link it, show it, explain it
2. **One workflow you've seen (anywhere) that's begging to be automated** 
 —and how you'd do it
3. **Why Pepper? Why this role? Why now?**

For more information, visit www.griffithfoods.com.
   

  

**Industrial Relations \& Legal Compliance**
* Liaise with labor department, factory inspectorate, PF/ESI authorities, and other statutory bodies.

* Conduct monthly labor management meetings and maintain all statutory records and registers.
* Prepare legal documentation, notices, responses, and support inspections or audits.
* Identify emerging IR risks and implement preventive measures during plant scale\-up or operational changes.


**Contractor Workforce Governance**
* Ensure full compliance of contract labor management as per CLRA and statutory norms.
* Monitor contractor adherence to PF, ESI, wages, working hours, and documentation standards.
* Drive recruitment, attendance control, and efficient deployment of contract workforce.
* Conduct audits of contractors/vendors to ensure governance and legal compliance.
* Manage manpower documentation for ongoing operations and expansion projects.


**Plant Statutory \& Safety Compliance**
* Oversee statutory requirements related to boiler, metrology, safety, environment, and PCB regulations.
* Ensure timely inspections, certifications, approvals, renewals, and statutory filings.
* Maintain all compliance statutory registers, licenses, renewals, and filings and documentation for audits, inspections, and regulatory visits and handle inspections, notices, and compliance audits.
* Coordinate welfare and safety activities in partnership with the plant safety team
* Welfare \& Safety: Oversee canteen, safety, and employee welfare activities in coordination with the safety team.
* Oversee statutory compliance for new plant expansion or equipment installation.


**Disciplinary \& Legal Matters**
* Draft and manage all legal documents, notices, and responses related to labor or statutory authorities.
* Handle grievances, misconduct cases, and disciplinary procedures legally.
* Conduct domestic enquiries and disciplinary actions with strict adherence to labor laws.
* Maintain documentation for legal defense in inspections or disputes.
* Completing initial reporting, accident investigations, communication work restrictions, claim adjuster correspondence, tracking and claim review analysis for settlement
* Draft charge sheets, warning letters, suspension and termination documentation.
* Represent the company in conciliation or labor proceedings if required.


**Risk Management \& Advisory**
* Advise management on statutory risks and gaps in compliance.
* Implement preventive measures to avoid legal violations or penalties.
* Keep management updated on changes in labor laws, environmental regulations, and plant statutory requirements.
* Ensure compliance during plant expansion, new shifts, or additional manpower deployment.
* Monitor overtime, working hours, wage structures, and safety compliance.
* Advise management on IR risks during rapid operational growth.


**HR Operations**
* Manage end\-to\-end HR operations at the plant, ensuring alignment with production priorities.
* Drive manpower planning and workforce budgeting in line with production forecasts.
* Oversee end\-to\-end recruitment and onboarding for plant workforce (permanent and contractual).
* Manage employee lifecycle processes including confirmation, transfers, promotions, and separations.
* Drive performance management implementation for plant employees.
* Responsible for payroll inputs, attendance systems, shift management, and statutory deductions.
* Lead employee engagement initiatives and foster positive shop\-floor culture.
* Implement training and development programs focused on skill enhancement and compliance.
* Ensure effective employee communication, engagement, and grievance handling.
* Support succession planning and capability building for critical plant roles.
* Collaborate with production, maintenance, quality, and safety teams to ensure smooth operations.
* Maintain plant HR dashboards (attrition, absenteeism, productivity, compliance status).

title: Human Resources Director
description:
***This role is only for Jaipur/ Noida in\-office with 7 days/ month exception***




  





**We're hiring for one of the most important roles at Aelum right now.** 




 Not the flashiest. Not the most visible externally. But the one that will determine whether this company scales well
 



  





**About Aelum \-** 




  





 We're a fast\-growing ServiceNow consulting firm. We've crossed 250 people. We're headed to 3X. And we need someone who has made that exact journey before — who knows what breaks at 300, what needs to be built at 500, and what separates companies that grow with integrity from those that grow with chaos.
 



  





**This Is Not a Maintenance Role** 




  





 You won't be inheriting a polished HR function and keeping it ticking.
 



 You'll be walking into a real, active growth environment — where we're making senior hires, managing performance across a technical workforce, protecting company agreements, and trying to hold culture together while the headcount doubles.
 



 The person we need has done this before. Has made mistakes doing it. And built systems that outlasted their personal involvement.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




  





**Culture \& Identity** 
 Define what Aelum stands for beyond its pitch deck. Translate values into behaviours, rituals, and accountability structures that scale with the company.
 



  





**Retention** 
 Attrition is a real challenge at our stage. You'll diagnose root causes, design interventions, and build systems that identify at\-risk employees before they resign — not after.
 



  





**Employee Relations \& Discipline** 
 Own the hard conversations. PIPs, disciplinary processes, agreement breaches, conflict resolution. Clear, fair, legally sound — and consistently enforced across the organisation.
 



  





**Compliance \& Contracts** 
 Audit and remediate employment agreements, NDAs, and policies. Build a governance framework that protects the company and treats employees with clarity.
 



  





**People Operations** 
 Rebuild or redesign core processes — onboarding, offboarding, performance cycles, compensation reviews — fit for a company that is growing fast and can't afford to operate on legacy processes.
 



  





**HR Team** 
 Hire and develop the internal HR function. Coach line managers. Be the person leaders turn to when things get complicated.
 



  





 Who We're Looking For
 



**Experience** 



* 10–15 years in HR, with at least 4–5 years in a senior leadership role
* Demonstrated experience scaling a company from
 **250 to 600\+ employees** 
 — this is non\-negotiable
* Deep hands\-on expertise in employee relations, disciplinary management, and employment law
* Strong background in rebuilding or professionalising talent acquisition
* Prior experience managing agreement breaches, sensitive investigations, or workforce restructuring



  





**The Person** 



* Commercially minded — you connect people decisions to revenue and growth outcomes
* Direct — you have difficult conversations without waiting to be asked
* Structured — you build processes that work without you being in the room
* Empathetic but firm — you care about people and enforce accountability, both without apology
* Experienced enough to know what the CEO doesn't need to hear, and confident enough to say what they do



  





**What Year One Looks Like** 




  





 Attrition \- Root cause diagnosed, retention framework live, voluntary exits declining
 



 Hiring \- Structured, scalable process across all functions
 



 Compliance \- All agreements audited, gaps remediated, policy framework in place
 



 Culture \- Values defined, operationalised, visible in day\-to\-day processes
 



 ER Framework \- Disciplinary and performance management framework live and in use
 



 HR Team \- Core team hired, trained, and operating independently
 



  





**Why This Role, Why Now** 



* You'll report directly to the COO and sit on the leadership team
* Greenfield build — you'll design, not inherit
* Competitive senior leadership compensation \+ performance bonus \+ equity participation
* Real mandate, real access, real impact

title: Training Manager
description:
**Senior Training Manager** 




 ZFunds \| Gurgaon \| Full\-Time
 



 Reports to: Head of Learning \& Development
 



**About the Role** 




  





 ZFunds is building a learning infrastructure that connects training directly to business outcomes — for our internal teams and for the MFD partners we serve across India. This role sits at the center of that effort. The Senior Training Manager is responsible for designing, delivering, and tracking training programs that improve performance at every level: new hires, tenured employees, and external MFD partners.
 



 This role carries full ownership — strategic and operational. The Senior Training Manager is expected to shape the learning agenda, not just deliver against it. Equal weight is placed on content creation and facilitation.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Internal Employee Training** 



* Design and deliver new hire onboarding and induction programs across functions and locations.
* Plan and execute structured On\-the\-Job Training (OJT) programs with defined milestones and evaluation checkpoints.
* Identify performance gaps through observation, data, and manager inputs; design targeted interventions.
* Maintain training calendars, attendance records, and completion trackers for all internal programs.
* Coordinate with department heads and HR on training schedules, cohort planning, and performance follow\-ups.



  





**MFD Partner Training** 



* Design and deliver training sessions for ZFunds' MFD partners — covering product knowledge, regulatory compliance, business development, and client communication.
* Support MFD certification pathways including NISM series examinations; plan prep sessions, mock tests, and revision modules.
* Build and maintain a content library of quizzes, case studies, assignments, and reference material mapped to competency levels.
* Provide ongoing mentorship and query resolution support to MFD learners.
* Host webinars and virtual sessions; comfortable appearing on digital platforms as a facilitator and subject matter resource.



  





**Content Development** 



* Create training decks, facilitation guides, workbooks, assessments, and self\-study materials from scratch.
* Convert complex financial and regulatory concepts into plain, learner\-ready content.
* Develop and maintain course content on the LMS; ensure materials are current, accurate, and mapped to learning outcomes.
* Review and refresh content periodically based on regulatory updates, product changes, and learner feedback.



  





**Analytics and Reporting** 



* Track and report on key training metrics: attendance, OJT completion, NISM certification pass rates, MFD activation, and assessment scores.
* Prepare and present training performance reports to the Head of Learning \& Development on a regular cadence.
* Use data to identify gaps, prioritize interventions, and measure program effectiveness over time.



  





**Requirements** 




  





**Experience and Knowledge** 



* 5\+ years of experience in the mutual fund or broader financial services industry, with a focus on training, distribution, or advisory roles.
* Demonstrated experience delivering both internal employee training and external partner or distributor training.
* Strong working knowledge of NISM certifications, AMFI regulatory framework, and industry compliance requirements.
* Hands\-on experience with LMS platforms — content upload, learner tracking, and reporting.
* Prior exposure to new hire onboarding and OJT program design is required.



  





**Skills** 



* Strong content creation skills — able to build training decks, assessments, and facilitation guides independently.
* Effective facilitator — can hold a room, manage diverse learner groups, and adapt delivery in real time.
* Comfortable with public speaking, webinar hosting, and appearing on digital platforms.
* Fluent in Hindi and English; able to simplify complex financial concepts for varied audiences.
* Proficient with MS Office / Google Workspace; familiarity with tools like Canva or similar for content design is a plus.



  





**Attributes** 



* High ownership. Takes responsibility for outcomes, not just task completion.
* Consistent and reliable. Shows up, follows through, and meets commitments without close supervision.
* Direct communicator. Comfortable escalating problems early and asking for help when needed.
* Learner mindset. Keeps up with regulatory updates, industry developments, and training best practices.



  





**Location and Travel** 




  





 Based in Gurgaon. Minimal travel may be required for internal training at other office locations.

 Role Overview
 



 We are looking for an HR Manager to independently lead the complete HR function for our India office. This is a hands\-on role involving talent acquisition, HR operations, payroll coordination, compliance, employee engagement, performance management, and partnering with leadership on people strategy.

description:
**Description**
 This is a contractual role
   

  

 At Amazon we believe that every day is still day one.
   

  

 We are working to be the most customer\-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you’d like to help the Disability Leave Services (DLS) team build a best\-in\-class professional services program to deliver leave of absence, disability and accommodation services to Amazon employees, applicants, job seekers and candidates globally, this is your chance to make history by joining the amazing Disability \& Leave Services Team.
   

  

 The DLS Case Manager provides case management for all types of leave of absence and disability life events. The DLS Case Manager is highly skilled in answering questions, understanding the employee’s situation, applying the appropriate benefits, responding to changing circumstances and needs, and paves the way for a connected and trusted case management experience. Case Managers are the single point of contact for an employee throughout an entire leave of absence or disability event.
   

  

 This is an individual contribution (IC) role with no direct reports.
   

  

**Essential Responsibilities**
* Initiate and respond to inquiries about leave and disability events, benefits, and options available to employees
* Serve as a point of contact for assigned employees to provide holistic case management services, including reviewing medical documentation to adjudicate leaves in compliance with the corresponding leave plans, federal and state laws and benefit plans as defined by Amazon
* Leverage duration guidelines, best practice tools and Amazon resources to support oversight of a leave event as appropriate
* Critically assess and adjust the case management plan to an employee’s changing needs
* Address and respond to sensitive situations
* Troubleshoot issues and seek to remove barriers before, during, or after a leave event
* Respond to employee impacting issues that may arise during the leave event and ensure the right communication occurs
* Identify and solve problems that may arise, sometimes with limited information
* Facilitate a smooth return to work and ramp\-back plan for employees returning to the workplace
* Educate managers and business partners on employee concerns and needs prior to being off or returning back to work
* Communicate regular updates to employees and stakeholders both verbally and in writing
* Ensure compliance with standard work, federal/state regulations, and company policy
* Maintain system records to ensure accurate and timely information/documentation
* Consult, coordinate and partner with our third party administrator, HR, Safety, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, team members and other departments/systems as appropriate
* Other duties as assigned


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 The DLS Case Manager serving as the single point of contact for employees throughout their entire leave or disability experience.
   

  

 Initiate and respond to inquiries regarding leave and disability events, benefits, and available options
   

  

 Provide holistic case management including reviewing medical documentation and adjudicating leaves in compliance with federal/state laws, leave plans, and company policy
   

  

 Leverage duration guidelines, best practice tools, and internal resources to manage leave events effectively
   

  

 Assess and adjust case management plans based on employees' changing needs and circumstances
   

  

 Address sensitive situations with professionalism and resolve barriers before, during, or after leave events
   

  

 Identify and solve problems proactively, sometimes with limited information
   

  

 Facilitate smooth return\-to\-work and ramp\-back plans for employees resuming duties
   

  

 Educate managers and business partners on employee needs related to leave transitions
   

  

 Communicate regular updates to employees and stakeholders verbally and in writing
   

  

 Maintain accurate system records and documentation in a timely manner
   

  

 Ensure compliance with standard work processes, federal/state regulations, and company policy
   

  

 Coordinate with third\-party administrators, HR, Safety, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, and other departments as needed
   

  

 This is an individual contributor (IC) role with no direct reports.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Daily activities include reviewing and adjudicating medical documentation, responding to employee and stakeholder inquiries, and updating case records in real time. Case Managers assess evolving employee needs, troubleshoot barriers, and coordinate with HR, Legal, Payroll, Safety, and third\-party administrators to resolve issues. They communicate decisions, next steps, and status updates to employees and managers both verbally and in writing. Additional activities include facilitating return\-to\-work plans, educating business partners on leave\-related processes, and ensuring all actions comply with federal/state regulations and company policy. Case Managers proactively identify risks, escalate sensitive situations, and apply best practice tools to drive timely case resolution

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a related field
* 2\+ years of customer service experience, or Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field
* Experience in direct customer support
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel

* Experience and knowledge in Six Sigma belts and process improvement initiatives.

 You will work with senior engineers to build reliable data pipelines, manage storage and compute environments, ensure data quality, and support integrations with third‑party data systems. This role is ideal for an early‑career engineer who enjoys working with distributed systems, storage platforms, networking fundamentals, and cloud‑native infrastructure.

* Understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, load balancing, VLANs, and network troubleshooting.
